reference: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanatumaini kuelewa jinsi sayari zinavyofanyiza, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyofanyiza, kwa kuwa nyota za nyota zilipigana na dunia muda mrefu uliopita.

source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
reference: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, alianza kuwa gavana mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini muswada mwezi uliopita kuhalalisha ndoa za watu wa jinsia moja.

source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
reference: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".
hypothesis: Alirejezea uvumi huo kuwa "mazungumzo ya kisiasa na upumbavu".

source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
reference: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.
hypothesis: Inasemekana atajiunga na uchaguzi wa rais mwaka 2016.

source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
reference: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.
hypothesis: NextGen ni mfumo ambao FAA inasema utawezesha ndege kuruka njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni ya mafuta kila mwaka na kupunguza uzalishaji wa kaboni.

source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
reference: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.
hypothesis: Inatumia teknolojia ya satellite tofauti na teknolojia ya zamani ya msingi wa radar ya ardhi ili kuruhusu wasimamizi wa trafiki ya hewa kutambua ndege kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapa rubani habari sahihi zaidi.

source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
reference: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.
hypothesis: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaofanywa na treni za chini ya ardhi hazitasimama Wembley, na mahali pa kujipikia magari na vituo vya kuegesha magari na kuendesha magari havitapatikani ardhini.

source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
reference: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.
hypothesis: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri iliibua uwezekano kwamba mchezo ungelazimika kucheza nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila mashabiki wa timu.

source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
reference: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.
hypothesis: Uchunguzi uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuunda spishi mpya ya ndege kwenye Visiwa vya Galápagos vya Ekuado.

source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
reference: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.
hypothesis: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton nchini Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala nchini Sweden waliripoti kwamba spishi mpya ilibadilika katika vizazi viwili tu, ingawa iliaminika kwamba mchakato huu ulichukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya uzazi kati ya Finch ya Darwin, Geospiza fortes, na Finch ya cactus ya wahamiaji, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
reference: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.
hypothesis: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa kwa aina mbalimbali.

source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
reference: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuvuta waya mwembamba, unaweza kugeuza na kuushika, unaweza kuufunga kwa chuma au kuufunga katika karatasi.

source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
reference: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa “miswada iliyoangazwa”.
hypothesis: Inaweza kutengenezwa kuwa nyembamba sana, na kushikamana na chuma kingine, na inaweza kutengenezwa kuwa nyembamba sana hivi kwamba wakati mwingine ilitumiwa kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono katika vitabu vinavyoitwa "nyaraka zilizoongozwa na nuru".

source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
reference: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.
hypothesis: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kufanya kiashiria kwa kutumia maji ya kabichi nyekundu.

source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
reference: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.
hypothesis: Maji ya kabichi hubadilika rangi kulingana na umbo la kemikali au umbo lake.

source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
reference: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.
hypothesis: Kiwango cha pH huonyeshwa na kiasi cha Hydrogen (H katika pH) ioni katika kemikali kuchunguzwa.

source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
reference: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).
hypothesis: Ion za hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilikuwa na elektroni zao zilizopigwa (kwa kuwa atomu za hidrojeni zinajumuisha protoni moja na elektron moja).

source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
reference: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.
hypothesis: Zungusha poda mbili kavu pamoja na kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, zifunge kwenye mpira.

source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
reference: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.
hypothesis: Unyevu wa mikono yako utaathiri tabaka za nje, na hivyo kuonekana kuwa la kushangaza na kutokeza aina fulani ya shell.

source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
reference: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.
hypothesis: Katika majiji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro, karibu kila nyumba ilikuwa na choo cha kutosha, kilichounganishwa na mfumo wa maji ya maji ya maji yaliyotengenezwa kwa njia ya maji.

source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
reference: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.
hypothesis: Mabaki ya mifumo ya maji ya maji yaliyotokana na maji yamepatikana katika nyumba za majiji ya Minoan ya Krete na Santorini nchini Ugiriki.

source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
reference: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.
hypothesis: Katika utamaduni wa Kiroma, kuna nyakati ambapo kuna bafu za umma ambazo wanaume na wanawake huungana katika ushirika wa watu.

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.
hypothesis: Unapomwita mtu aliye mbali sana, unatumia satelaiti.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.
hypothesis: Satelaiti ya anga hupokea simu na kisha kuirejelea nyuma, karibu papo hapo.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi hutumia teleskopo katika anga kwa sababu angahewa ya dunia hupotosha sehemu fulani ya nuru na maono yetu.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.
hypothesis: Inahitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 ili kuweka satellite au teleskopo katika anga.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.
hypothesis: Gari limebadilisha ulimwengu kwa njia za ajabu, jambo kubwa ambalo gari limefanya kwa ajili yetu ni kutupa usafiri rahisi na wa haraka zaidi.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.
hypothesis: Imetuletea gari-moshi, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya usafiri.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.
hypothesis: Chini ya hao kuna paka wa ukubwa wa kati zaidi ambao hula wanyama wa kawaida kuanzia sungura hadi viumbe wa kawaida.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.
hypothesis: Mwishowe, kuna paka wadogo wengi (ikiwa ni pamoja na paka wa kufugwa) ambao hula wanyama wadogo wengi zaidi kama vile wadudu, wadudu, nzige, na ndege.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.
hypothesis: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni wazo la niche, kazi ya pekee ambayo kila paka anafanya ambayo humzuia kushindana na wengine.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.
hypothesis: Simba ni paka wenye urafiki wa karibu zaidi, wanaoishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa viumbe wenye fahari.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.
hypothesis: Wanyama wa kiume wenye kuzaliwa wakiwa na uhusiano wa kiume na wa kiume, pamoja na wanawake na watoto wa kike wapatao 30.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, wanawake hao ni jamaa wa karibu, nao ni familia kubwa ya dada na binti.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.
hypothesis: Simba wenye kiburi hujiendesha kama makundi ya mbwa-mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao ni wa kushangaza kama simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) katika tabia, na pia ni hatari sana kwa mateka yao.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa ni mwanariadha mwenye nguvu, anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka umbali mrefu, na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano zaidi ya nguvu za mwanadamu mwenye nguvu.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.
hypothesis: Simba ni wa jamii moja (Genus Panthera) na simba, chui, na jaguar.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.
hypothesis: Kilio cha simbamarara si kama kilio cha simba chenye sauti kubwa, bali ni kama sentensi ya maneno yenye kuogofya na yenye kupaaza sauti.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.
hypothesis: Ocelots kama kula wanyama wadogo. wao kupata tufe, nyoka, wadudu na ndege kama wanaweza. karibu wote wa wanyama kwamba ocelot hunya ni ndogo sana kuliko ni.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanafikiri kwamba ocelots hufuata na kupata wanyama wa kula (wanyama) kwa harufu, wakicheka mahali walipokuwa kwenye ardhi.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.
hypothesis: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana katika giza na kuona usiku, na huenda kwa siri sana pia.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.
hypothesis: Wakati kikundi kidogo cha viumbe hai (jamii ndogo) kinatenganishwa na idadi kubwa ya watu waliotoka (kama wanavyohamia kwenye mlima au mto, au wanapohamia kisiwa kipya ili wasiweze kurudi kwa urahisi) mara nyingi wanajikuta katika mazingira tofauti na yale waliyokuwa nayo hapo awali.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.
hypothesis: mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, hivyo idadi ya watu mpya itahitaji sifa tofauti au mabadiliko ili kuwa mshindani imara kuliko kile walichohitaji awali.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.
hypothesis: Idadi ya awali ya watu haijabadilika hata kidogo, bado wanahitaji mageuzi yaleyale kama ilivyokuwa hapo awali.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.
hypothesis: Baada ya muda, kadiri idadi ya watu wanavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, ndivyo wanavyoanza kuonekana kuwa tofauti na idadi ya watu wengine.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.
hypothesis: Hatimaye, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, idadi hiyo ya watu itaonekana tofauti sana hivi kwamba haiwezi kuitwa jamii ileile.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.
hypothesis: Tunaita mchakato huu aina, ambayo inamaanisha tu kuunda spishi mpya. Aina ni matokeo ya lazima na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).
hypothesis: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo wanadamu huvuta, na huchukua kaboni dioksidi ambayo wanadamu huvuta (yaani, huvuta nje).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli
hypothesis: Mimea huandaa chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia mchanganyiko wa nuru.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.
hypothesis: Tunajenga nyumba zetu kwa mimea na mavazi yetu kwa mimea. Chakula chetu kikubwa ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus alikuwa mnyama mkubwa zaidi wa wakati wake, kwa hiyo hakuogopa chochote, isipokuwa mosasaurus wengine.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.
hypothesis: Machozi yake marefu yalikuwa yamejaa meno zaidi ya 70 yenye makali kama makali ya mkuki, na pia kulikuwa na kitambaa cha ziada kwenye paa la kinywa chake, ikimaanisha kwamba hakukuwa na njia ya kutoroka kwa chochote kilichopakana na njia yake.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.
hypothesis: Hatujui, lakini huenda alikuwa na ulimi uliovunjika, chakula chake kilikuwa na samaki wakubwa, samaki wakubwa, na wanyama wengine wa mwitu, na huenda hata alikuwa mnyama wa kula.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.
hypothesis: Pia, ilipiga chochote kilichoingia ndani ya maji; hata dinosauri mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangeweza kulishinda.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse
hypothesis: Ingawa chakula chao kikubwa huenda kilikuwa cha kawaida kwetu, Waroma walifurahia chakula cha ajabu au cha ajabu, kutia ndani nguruwe, paa, buibui, na aina ya mzuizi anayeitwa panya

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.
hypothesis: Tofauti nyingine ni kwamba wakati maskini na mwanamke walikula chakula chao wakiwa wameketi kwenye viti, wanaume matajiri walipenda kufanya karamu pamoja ambapo wangelala kando yao walipokula chakula chao.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.
hypothesis: Vyakula vya kale vya Waroma havikuweza kutia ndani vyakula vilivyokuja Ulaya kutoka Amerika au Asia katika karne zilizofuata.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, nyanya, viazi, au kakao, na hakuna Waroma wa kale waliopata kula kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.
hypothesis: Wababiloni walijenga hekalu la msingi kwa kila mmoja wa miungu yao ambalo lilionwa kuwa makao ya mungu huyo.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.
hypothesis: Watu walitoa dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wakajaribu kutunza mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na sherehe.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.
hypothesis: Kila hekalu lilikuwa na ua wa hekalu ulio wazi na kisha patakatifu pa ndani ambapo makuhani tu ndio wangeweza kuingia.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.
hypothesis: Nyakati nyingine minara ya pekee yenye umbo la piramidi, inayoitwa ziggurats, ilijengwa ili kuwa sehemu ya mahekalu.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Sehemu ya juu ilikuwa makao matakatifu ya mungu.
hypothesis: Juu ya mnara huo kulikuwa na mahali patakatifu pa mungu huyo.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Katika hali joto ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.
hypothesis: Katika hali ya hewa ya joto ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Sehemu kubwa ya maisha ya familia ya Kiebrania ilifanyikia nje.
hypothesis: Maisha mengi ya familia ya Waebrania yalitukia nje.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Wanawake walifanya mapishi kwenye yadi; stoo zilikuwa kaunta wazi tu zilizoelekea barabarani. Mawe yalitumika kujengea barabara.
hypothesis: Wanawake walifanya kazi ya kupika katika ua; maduka yalikuwa tu na dawati la wazi linaloangalia barabara.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Hakukua na misitu mikubwa kwenye ardhi ya Canaan, kwa hivyo mbao ziliuzwa kwa bei ghali mno.
hypothesis: Hakukuwa na misitu mikubwa katika nchi ya Kanaani, kwa hiyo mbao zilikuwa ghali sana.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland ilikuwa na watu chache. Katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik aliye Mwekundu alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati wa kusafiri Magharibi zaidi, aliipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.
hypothesis: Katika hadithi za Norse, Erik Mwekundu alifukuzwa Iceland kwa sababu ya mauaji, na alipokuwa akisafiri magharibi, alipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Lakina licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo yalikuwa tayari yanaishi huko wakati huo.
hypothesis: Lakini licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Waskimos yalikuwa tayari yakiishi huko wakati huo.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa ya 'Kiskandinavia', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, mila na historia za Denmaki, Uswidi, Norway na Aislandi.
hypothesis: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa 'Scandinavian,' kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, desturi na historia ya Denmark, Sweden, Norway na Iceland.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Iwapo umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.
hypothesis: Ikiwa umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri kwamba baraza la hazina liliandikwa kwenye nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati, si ramani ya hazina.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli, kwa kuwa ingawa kuna kitu fulani kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati hiyo, si ramani ya hazina.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kuliandikwa maneno “Tangazo halisi la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776”. Maandishi hayo yako katika sehemu ya chini ya hati, juu chini.
hypothesis: Kwenye nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kulikuwa na maneno "Tangazo la Kwanza la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776".

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Wakati hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina vipimo vya inchi 29¾ kwa inchi 24½) ilikunjwa kwa uhifadhi.
hypothesis: Ingawa hakuna anayejua kwa uhakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba mapema katika maisha yake, hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina ukubwa wa inchi 293⁄4 kwa inchi 241⁄2) iliviringishwa ili kuhifadhiwa.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: Kwa hivyo, kuna uwezekano kuwa nukuu liliongezwa liwe kama ishara.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, ni jambo la hakika kwamba maandishi hayo yaliongezwa tu kama lebo.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Utuaji siku ya shambulio na mapigano yaliyofuata yalikuwa yameweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.
hypothesis: Kuwasili kwa siku ya D na vita vilivyofuata vilikuwa vimewaweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini bado kusini halikuwa huru.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Ilitawaliwa na Wafaransa wa “Vichy”. Hawa walikuwa watu wa Ufaransa ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mnamo 1940 na kufanya kazi na washambulizi badala ya kupigana nao.
hypothesis: Ufaransa ulikuwa umetawaliwa na Wafaransa "Vichy", ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mwaka wa 1940 na kufanya kazi pamoja na wavamizi badala ya kupigana nao.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Mnamo Agosti 15 1940, Majeshi ya Kirafiki yalishambulia Ufaransa kusini, shambulio liliitwa "Operesheni Dragoon".
hypothesis: Mnamo Agosti 15, 1940, Waasi walivamia kusini mwa Ufaransa, uvamizi huo uliitwa "Operation Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Kwa kipindi cha majuma mawili tu vikosi vya Marekani na Ufaransa Huru vilikuwa vimekomboa Ufaransa kusini na vilikuwa vikielekea Ujerumani.
hypothesis: Katika majuma mawili tu, majeshi ya Marekani na ya Ufaransa ya Uhuru yalikuwa yameondoa kusini mwa Ufaransa na yalikuwa yakielekea Ujerumani.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Ustaarabu ni utamaduni wa umoja unaoshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.
hypothesis: Utamaduni ni utamaduni wa pekee unaoshirikiwa na kikundi kikubwa cha watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Neno ustaarabu hutoka katika civilis la Kilatini, ambalo linamaanisha ya kiraia, linalohusiana na civis la Kilatini, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha mji au jimbo la mji, na ambalo kwa namna fulani linaelezea ukubwa wa jamii.
hypothesis: Neno ustaarabu linatokana na Kilatini civilis, linalomaanisha raia, linalolingana na Kilatini civis, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha jiji au jiji-mtawala, na hilo pia kwa namna fulani hufafanua ukubwa wa jamii.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Majimbo ya miji hutanguliza mataifa. Utamaduni wa kistaarabu huashiria kupitishwa kwa maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, wayo wa kitamaduni unaoendelea kukaa kwa muda na usambazaji wenye haki.
hypothesis: Utamaduni wa kitamaduni unamaanisha kupitishwa kwa ujuzi kwa vizazi kadhaa, alama ya kitamaduni ya kudumu na kueneza haki.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hutoweka bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria na kukosa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu barabara.
hypothesis: Utamaduni mdogo mara nyingi hupotea bila kuacha uthibitisho wa kihistoria unaofaa na hukosa kutambuliwa kama tamaduni sahihi.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati – huku Bunge la Marekani likiwa ndiyo sehemu yake pekee – chini ya Vifungu vya Shirikisho.
hypothesis: Wakati wa Vita vya Uhuru, majimbo kumi na tatu kwanza waliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati na Congress kuwa sehemu yake pekee chini ya Vifungu vya Ushirika.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Kongamano lilikosa uwezo wowote wa kuweka ushuru, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na mtendaji wa kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka ya taifa, ambao mara nyingi hawakuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza sheria zake.
hypothesis: Congress haikuwa na mamlaka yoyote ya kuwekeza kodi, na kwa kuwa hakukuwa na serikali ya kitaifa au mahakama, ilitegemea mamlaka za serikali, ambazo mara nyingi hazikufanya kazi kwa pamoja, ili kutekeleza sheria zake zote.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Pia haikuwa na mamlaka ya kupuuza sheria na orodha za ushuru kati ya majimbo.
hypothesis: Pia, haikuwa na mamlaka ya kuondoa sheria za kodi na kodi kati ya majimbo.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Vifungu vilihitaji ridhaa ya pamoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kurekebishwa na majimbo yalichukulia serikali kuu kwa mzaha sana kiasi kwamba mara nyingi wawakilishi wao hawakuwepo.
hypothesis: Vifungu vilihitaji idhini ya wote kabla ya kuweza kuhariri na majimbo yalichukua serikali ya kati kwa uzito sana hivi kwamba wawakilishi wao mara nyingi walikosa.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Timu ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya soka ya Ujerumani ndiyo timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na ilikuwa bingwa wa kikombe cha dunia cha FIFA mwaka wa 2006.
hypothesis: Italia ya taifa ya soka, pamoja na timu ya taifa ya mpira wa miguu ya Ujerumani ni timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi ulimwenguni na walikuwa mabingwa wa Kombe la Dunia la FIFA mnamo 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
reference: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na kandanda, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa wavu, polo ya majini, mchezo wa uzio, raga, uendeshaji baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gogo na mashindano ya magari ya F1.
hypothesis: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na mpira wa miguu, mpira wa kikapu, volleyball, water polo, ngome, rugby, baiskeli, ice hockey, roller hockey na mashindano ya magari ya F1.

source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
reference: Spoti za msimu wa baridi ni maarufu sana katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, ambako Waitaliano hushindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na ya Olimpiki.
hypothesis: Michezo ya majira ya baridi ni maarufu zaidi katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, na Waitaliano wanashindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na mashindano ya Olimpiki.

source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
reference: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
hypothesis: Japani ina visiwa 7,000 hivi (kwa kuwa kikubwa zaidi ni Honshu), na hivyo Japani ni kisiwa cha 7 kwa ukubwa ulimwenguni!

source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
reference: Kwa sababu ya mafungu/vikundi vya visiwa Japani ilivyo navyo, mara nyingi Japani huitwa, kwa msimamo wa kijiografia, "funguvisiwa"
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya kundi la visiwa Japan ina, Japan mara nyingi hujulikana, katika msimamo wa kijiografia, kama "misiwa"

source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
reference: Taiwan ilianza nyuma kitambo katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Kiingereza wanaopita hurekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.
hypothesis: Taiwan kuanza kurejea mbali nyuma katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia Ulaya kupita kwa rekodi kisiwa jina kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.

source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
reference: Mnamo 1624, kampuni ya Dutch East India ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, kuanzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka na kuwaajili wafanyakazi wa Kichina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba ya mpunga na sukari.
hypothesis: Mnamo 1624, Kampuni ya Uholanzi ya India Mashariki ilianzisha makao yake ya msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, ikianzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka ya wenyeji na kuajiri wafanyikazi Wachina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba yake ya mchele na sukari.

source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
reference: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Milki ya Qing mnamo 1885.
hypothesis: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini mwa Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Dola ya Qing mnamo 1885.

source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
reference: Mnamo 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika vita vya kwanza vya Sino-Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing yatia sahihi mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao kwao inadhihirisha uhuru juu ya Taiwan hadi Japani, ambayo inaongoza kisiwa hadi 1945.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika Vita vya Kwanza vya China na Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing ilisaini Mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao ulitoa uhuru wa Taiwan kwa Japani, ambayo ilitawala kisiwa hicho hadi 1945.

source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
reference: Machu Picchu ina mifumo kuu mitatu, kwa majina Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba chenye Madirisha Matatu.
hypothesis: Machu Picchu ina majengo matatu makuu, yaani, Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba cha Madirisha Matatu.

source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
reference: Nyumba nyingi kwenye kingo za majengo hayo tata zilijengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii taswira bora ya jinsi zilivyokuwa mwanzoni.
hypothesis: Majengo mengi yaliyo kwenye mipaka ya jengo hilo yamerekodiwa ili kuwapa watalii wazo zuri zaidi la jinsi yalivyoonekana mwanzoni.

source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
reference: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerejeshwa na urejesho unaendelea hadi leo.
hypothesis: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia 30 ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imeponywa na kazi hiyo inaendelea mpaka leo.

source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
reference: Kwa mfano, umbizo la upigaji picha tuli wa kawaida zaidi duniani ni milimita 35, ambayo ndiyo iliyokuwa saizi kuu ya filamu katika zama za sinema za kikale.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, muundo wa picha ya picha ya picha ya kawaida ulimwenguni ni 35mm, ambayo ilikuwa saizi ya filamu inayoongoza mwishoni mwa enzi ya filamu ya analog.

source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
reference: Bado inatolewa hadi wa leo, lakini kwa umuhimu zaidi uwiano wa kipengele chake umerithiwa na umbizo za kihisio cha picha za kamera za kidijitali.
hypothesis: Bado hutengenezwa leo, lakini muhimu zaidi, uwiano wake wa sura umerithiwa na muundo wa sensor ya picha ya kamera ya dijiti.

source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
reference: Muundo wa 35mm kwa kweli, kwa kiasi Fulani unachanganya, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.
hypothesis: Umbizo la 35mm ni kweli, kiasi cha kuchanganyikiwa, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.

source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
reference: Uwiano-vipimo wa muundo huu (kugawa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa namba kamili) basi husemekana kuwa 3:2.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, uwiano wa sura ya muundo huu (kugawanya kwa kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi wa jumla) unasemekana kuwa 3:2.

source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
reference: Miundo mingi ya kawaida (familia ya APS ya miundoi, kwa mfano) ni sawa na au takribani sawa na uwiano huu.
hypothesis: Maumbizo mengi ya kawaida (APS familia ya maumbizo, kwa mfano) ni sawa au karibu karibu na uwiano wa kipengele hiki.

source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
reference: Sheria ya thuluthi inayotumiwa vibaya na kudhihakiwa mara nyingi ni mwongozo rahisi unaounda uwezo huku ukidumisha kiwango cha mpango katika picha.
hypothesis: Kanuni ya tatu, ambayo hutumiwa vibaya sana na mara nyingi hufanywa mzaha, ni mwongozo rahisi wa kujenga nguvu huku ikihifadhi utaratibu katika picha.

source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
reference: Inasema kwamba mahali palipo na athari kubwa kwa mada kuu ni katika mkutano wa mistari inayogawanya picha kwa thuluthi wima na mshazari (tazama mfano).
hypothesis: Inasema kwamba mahali pa ufanisi zaidi kwa somo kuu ni kwenye msalaba wa mistari ambayo inachanganya picha katika theluthi moja kwa usawa na usawa (tazama mfano).

source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
reference: Katika kipindi hiki cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambalo lilikuwa tajiri na lenye nguvu, likawa chini ya uchunguzi.
hypothesis: Katika kipindi hicho cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambalo lilikuwa limepata utajiri na nguvu, lilichunguzwa kwa makini.

source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
reference: kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja dini ya Kikristo imefunga majimbo ya Uropa pamoja licha ya kuwa na lugha na mila tofauti. I
hypothesis: Kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja dini ya Kikristo ilikuwa imeunganisha mataifa ya Ulaya licha ya tofauti za lugha na desturi.

source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
reference: Nguvu zake zilizoenea kote ziliathiri wote toka mfalme hadi mtu wa kawaida.
hypothesis: Nguvu yake yenye kuenea sana iliathiri kila mtu, kuanzia mfalme hadi mtu wa kawaida.

source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
reference: Mojawapo ya kanuni kuu za Kikristo ni kwamba mali inafaa kutumika kupunguza mateso na umasikini na kwamba hazina za kifedha za kanisa ziko hapo hususan kwa sababu hiyo.
hypothesis: Mojawapo ya mafundisho makuu ya Kikristo ni kwamba utajiri wapaswa kutumiwa kupunguza mateso na umaskini na kwamba fedha za kanisa ziko hapo hasa kwa sababu hiyo.

source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
reference: Mamlaka kuu ya kanisa yalikuwa katika Roma kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu na uwepo huu wa mamlaka na pesa katika sehemu moja ulipelekea wengi kuuuliza kama itikadi hii ilikuwa ikitekelezwa.
hypothesis: Mamlaka kuu ya kanisa ilikuwa imewekwa Roma kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja na ushirikiano huo wa nguvu na pesa uliwafanya wengi waulize ikiwa fundisho hilo lilitimizwa.

source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
reference: Baada tu ya kuzuka kwa uhasama, Uingereza ilianzisha kizuizi cha kinevi dhidi ya Ujerumani.
hypothesis: Muda mfupi baada ya vita kuanza, Uingereza ilianzisha kizuizi cha bahari dhidi ya Ujerumani.

source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
reference: Mkakati ulikuwa na ufanisi, kukatisha vifaa muhimu vya kijeshi na kiraia, ingawa kizuizi hiki kilikiuka sheria ya kimataifa ambayo inakubaliwa kwa jumla iliyoratibiwa na mikataba kadhaa ya kimataifa katika karne mbili zilizopita.
hypothesis: Mkakati huo ulikuwa na matokeo mazuri, ukikata vifaa muhimu vya kijeshi na vya kiraia, ingawa kizuizi hicho kilivunja sheria ya kimataifa inayokubalika kwa ujumla iliyoandikwa na makubaliano kadhaa ya kimataifa ya karne mbili zilizopita.

source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
reference: Uingereza ilitega mabomu kwenye maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli zozote kuingia sehemu nzima za bahari, hivyo kuweka hatari hata kwa meli zisizoegemea upande wowote.
hypothesis: Uingereza ilichimba maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli yoyote kuingia katika sehemu kamili za bahari, ikisababisha hatari hata kwa meli zisizo na upande wowote.

source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
reference: Kwa kuwa kulikuwa na mwitikio mdogo kwa mbinu hii, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo kwa vita vyake ambavyo havijazuiliwa vya chini ya bahari.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa kulikuwa na majibu machache kwa mbinu hiyo, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo kwa vita vyake vya chini ya maji visivyo na mipaka.

source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
reference: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa raia na mataifa mengi uliotawala ulikuwa wa upatanisho na utengaji.
hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa raia na mataifa mengi ulikuwa wa amani na kutengwa.

source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
reference: Baada ya kuona mambo ya kuogofya na ukatili wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, mataifa yalitamani kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena wakati ujao.
hypothesis: Baada ya kuona ukatili na ukatili wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Ulimwengu, mataifa yalitamani kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena wakati ujao.

source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
reference: Katika mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison katika Jiji la New York.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani ili kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison huko New York City.

source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
reference: Aliwasili Marekani na peni 4 tu, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya kupendekeza kutoka kwa Charles Batchelor (meneja wake katika ajira yake ya awali) kwa Thomas Edison.
hypothesis: Alifika Marekani na senti 4 kwa jina lake, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya mapendekezo kutoka Charles Batchelor (msimamizi wake katika kazi yake ya awali) kwa Thomas Edison.

source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
reference: Uchina ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya kipekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya wakati; kila hatua ya Uchina au kila familia iliyokuwa mamlakani ilikuwa nasaba maalumu.
hypothesis: China ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya pekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya wakati; kila hatua ya China au kila familia iliyokuwa na mamlaka ilikuwa nasaba ya kipekee.

source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
reference: Pia kati ya kila nasaba kilikuwa kipindi kisicho na msimamo cha majimbo yaliyogawanyika. Maarufu sana kati ya vipindi hivi ilikuwa enzi za Falme Tatu za ya Han na Jin.
hypothesis: Pia kati ya kila nasaba kulikuwa na umri wa migogoro ya mikoa iliyoshirikiwa.

source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
reference: Wakati wa vipindi hivi vita vikali vilifanyika kati ya waangwana wakipigania kiti cha enzi.
hypothesis: Katika kipindi hicho kulikuwa na vita vya nguvu kati ya wakuu wengi waliokuwa wakipigania kiti cha ufalme.

source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
reference: Falme Tatu ilikuwa enzi yenye umwagaji damu zaidi katika historia ya China ya Kale, maelfu ya watu walikufa wakipigania kuketi kwenye kiti cha juu zaidi katika ikulu ya Xi'an.
hypothesis: Ufalme Mtatatu ulikuwa mojawapo ya enzi zenye umwagaji damu mwingi zaidi katika historia ya China ya kale. Maelfu ya watu walikufa wakipigana ili kuketi kwenye kiti cha juu zaidi katika jumba kubwa la kifalme huko Xian.

source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
reference: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na kisiasa kama vile utumiaji wa mfumo wa metriki, mabadiliko kutoka kwa msimamo wa udikteta hadi ujamhuri, utaifa na imani kuwa inchi ni ya watu si ya mtawala mmoja pekee.
hypothesis: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na kisiasa kama vile matumizi ya mfumo wa metric, mabadiliko kutoka uthabiti kwa Republicanism, taifa na imani nchi ni mali ya watu si mtawala mmoja.

source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
reference: Pia baada ya Mapinduzi kazi ilikuwa wazi kwa waombaji wote wa kiume, hivyo kuruhusu waliojitakia makuu na wenye mafanikio kufaulu.
hypothesis: Pia baada ya Mapinduzi kazi zilikuwa wazi kwa waombaji wote wa kiume kuruhusu ambitious na mafanikio ya kufanikiwa.

source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
reference: Vilevile kwa wanajeshi kwa sababu badala ya madaraka ya kijeshi kutegemea darasa sasa yanategemea sifa.
hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo ni kwa ajili ya jeshi kwa sababu badala ya cheo jeshi kulingana na darasa sasa ni kulingana na cailaber.

source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
reference: Mapinduzi ya Kifaransa pia yalichochea wafanyakazi wengine wengi wa nchi nyingine waliokandamizwa kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.
hypothesis: Mapinduzi ya Ufaransa pia yaliwachochea watu wengine wengi wa jamii ya wafanyakazi waliokandamizwa wa nchi nyingine kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.

source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
reference: Muhammad alivutiwa sana na mambo zaidi ya maisha haya ya kawaida. Alikuwa akitembelea sana pango ambalo lilikuja kujulikana kama "Hira" katika mlima wa "Noor" (nuru) kwa kutafakari.
hypothesis: Muhammad alikuwa na nia ya kina katika mambo zaidi ya maisha haya ya kidunia. Alikuwa mara kwa mara kutembelea pango ambalo lilijulikana kama Hira kwenye Mlima wa Noor (nuru) kwa kutafakari.

source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
reference: Pango lenyewe, ambalo lilinusurika nyakati, hutoa picha dhahiri ya mielekeo ya kiroho ya Muhammad.
hypothesis: pango yenyewe, ambayo imeokoka nyakati, hutoa picha ya wazi sana ya tabia za kiroho za Muhammad.

source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
reference: Likiwa juu ya mojawapo ya milima kaskazini mwa Mecca, pango hilo limetengwa kabisa na ulimwengu.
hypothesis: Yakiwa juu ya mlima mmoja kaskazini mwa Mecca, pango hilo limejitenga kabisa na ulimwengu wote.

source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
reference: Kwa kweli, si rahisi kupata kamwe hata kama mtu alijua ipo. Ukishaingia kwenye pango, umetengwa kabisa.
hypothesis: Kwa kweli, si rahisi kuipata hata ikiwa mtu alijua kwamba ilikuwako.

source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
reference: Hakuna kingine kinachoweza kuonekana ila anga safi na nzuri huko juu na milima mingi inayolizunguka. Ni machache sana ya dunia hii yanayoweza kuonwa au kusikiwa ndani ya pango hili.
hypothesis: Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuonekana isipokuwa anga safi na zuri juu na milima mingi inayozunguka.

source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
reference: Piramidi kuu katika Giza ndiyo ya pekee ya maajabu saba ambayo bado inasimama leo.
hypothesis: Piramidi Kuu ya Giza ndiyo pekee kati ya maajabu saba ambayo bado yapo leo.

source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
reference: Piramidi Kuu iliyojengwa na Wamisri katika karne ya tatu BCE ni mojawapo ya majengo makubwa yaliyojengwa kwa heshima ya Firauni waliofariki.
hypothesis: Iliyojengwa na Wamisri katika karne ya tatu K.W.K., Piramidi Kuu ni mojawapo ya majengo makubwa ya piramidi yaliyojengwa ili kumheshimu Farao aliyekufa.

source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
reference: Kilima cha Giza, au "Giza Necropolis" katika Bonde la Wafu la Misri kina piramidi kadhaa (ambazo piramidi kuu ni kubwa zaidi), makaburi kadhaa madogo, hekalu kadhaa, na Sphinx kuu.
hypothesis: Mlima wa Giza, au "Nekropoli ya Giza" katika Bonde la Wafu la Misri una piramidi kadhaa (ambayo piramidi kubwa ni kubwa zaidi), makaburi kadhaa madogo, mahekalu kadhaa, na Sphinx kubwa.

source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
reference: Piramidi kuu iliundwa ili kumheshimu Firauni Khufu, na piramidi, makaburi na mahekalu mengine mengi madogo yalijengwa ili kuheshimu wake na wanafamilia wa Khufu.
hypothesis: Piramidi kubwa ilijengwa ili kumheshimu Farao Khufu, na piramidi, makaburi, na mahekalu mengi madogo yalijengwa ili kuheshimu wake na washiriki wa familia ya Khufu.

source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
reference: Alama ya "gubeti la juu" inaonekana kama V na "alama ya gubeti la chini" kama kibanio au mraba unaokosa upande wake wa chini.
hypothesis: Alama ya "up bow" inaonekana kama V na alama ya "down bow" kama kipande cha msingi au mraba ambao hauonekani upande wake wa chini.

source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
reference: Juu inamaanisha unapaswa kuanzia nchani na kusukuma uta, na chini inamaanisha unafaa kuanzia kwenye frog (mahali ambapo mkono wako unashikilia uta) na kuvuta uta.
hypothesis: Juu inamaanisha unapaswa kuanza kutoka ncha na kushinikiza uta, na chini inamaanisha unapaswa kuanza kutoka kwa mbawakawa (ambako ni ambapo mkono wako ni kushikilia uta) na kuvuta uta.

source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
reference: Upinde wa juu kwa kawaida huzalisha sauti tulivu, huku upinde wa chini ukiwa na nguvu na ni imara zaidi.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, up-bow hutoa sauti laini zaidi, huku up-bow ya chini ikitokeza sauti yenye nguvu zaidi na yenye nguvu zaidi.

source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
reference: Jisikie huru kuandika kwa penseli alama zako, lakini kumbuka alama za kuinama zilizochapwa ziko kwa sababu ya kimziki, kwa hivyo yafaa ziheshimiwe.
hypothesis: Jisikie huru kuandika alama zako mwenyewe, lakini kumbuka alama za kupiga magoti zilizochapishwa ziko hapo kwa sababu ya muziki, kwa hiyo kwa kawaida zinapaswa kuheshimiwa.

source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
reference: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette, watoto wao wawili wadogo (Marie Therese mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Louis Charles mwenye umri wa miaka minne) na dada ya mfalme Bibi Elizabeth waliojawa na hofu, mnamo Oktoba 6 1789 walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles na umati wa wanawake wa sokoni.
hypothesis: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette waliogopa watoto wao wawili wadogo (wa miaka 11 Marie Therese na miaka minne Louis-Charles) na dada wa Mfalme, Madam Elizabeth, mnamo 6 Oktoba 1789 walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles na umati wa wanawake wa soko.

source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
reference: Katika gari la kukokotwa, walisafiri kuelekea Paris wakiwa wamezungukwa na umati wa watu waliopiga nduru na kutoa vitisho kwa Mfalme na Malkia kwa sauti kubwa.
hypothesis: Walipanda gari na kurudi Paris wakiwa wamezungukwa na umati wa watu waliokuwa wakipiga kelele na kutisha Mfalme na Malkia.

source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
reference: Umati wa watu uliwalazimisha Mfalme Na Malkia kufungua madirisha ya gari lao.
hypothesis: Umati wa watu uliwalazimisha Mfalme na Malkia waache madirisha yao ya gari yawe wazi.

source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
reference: Kwa wakati mmoja memba wa umati alipunga kichwa cha mlinzi mmoja wa kifalme aliyeuawa katika Versailles mbele ya Malkia aliyejawa na hofu.
hypothesis: Wakati mmoja mshiriki mmoja wa umati wa watu alitikisa kichwa cha askari wa gereza la kifalme aliyeuawa huko Versailles mbele ya Malkia aliyekuwa na hofu.

source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
reference: Matumizi ya kivita kwa ubeberu wa Marekani katika ushindi dhidi ya Ufilipino yaligharimiwa na watu wa Ufilipino wenyewe.
hypothesis: Gharama za vita za utawala wa Marekani katika kushindwa kwa Ufilipino zililipwa na watu wa Ufilipino wenyewe.

source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
reference: Walilazimishwa kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya wakoloni ya Amerika ili kugharamia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba juu ya dhamana zilizowekwa kwa jina la serikali ya Ufilipino kupitia nyumba za benki za Wall Street.
hypothesis: Walilazimika kulipa kodi kwa utawala wa kikoloni wa Marekani ili kulipia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba ya bonds zilizotiririka kwa jina la serikali ya Ufilipino kupitia nyumba za benki za Wall Street.

source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
reference: Bila shaka, faida kubwa kutokana na dhuluma za muda mrefu za watu wa Ufilipino ziliunda mapato ya msingi ya ubeberu wa Marekani.
hypothesis: Bila shaka, faida kubwa sana za kutumia vibaya watu wa Filipino kwa muda mrefu zingekuwa faida za msingi za utawala wa Marekani.

source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
reference: Ili kuelewa templar ni lazima mtu aelewe muktadha ambao ulisababisha uundaji wa agizo.
hypothesis: Ili kuelewa Watempeli, ni lazima tuelewe muktadha uliosababisha kuanzishwa kwa utaratibu huo.

source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
reference: Kipindi ambacho matukio yalitokea kwa kawaida hujulikana kama Enzi za Juu za kati, kipindi katika historia ya Ulaya katika Karne za 11, 12, na 13 (1000-1300 Baada ya Kristo).
hypothesis: Umri ambapo matukio hayo yalifanyika ni kawaida hujulikana kama High Middle Ages kipindi cha historia ya Ulaya katika 11th, 12th, na 13th karne (AD 10001300).

source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
reference: Enzi za Juu za Kati zilitanguliwa na Enzi za Mapema za Kati na kufuatiwa na Enzi za Mwisho za Kati, ambazo kwa mapatano zinaishia karibu 1500.
hypothesis: Enzi za Kati zilianza mapema na baadaye zilianza mwishoni mwa enzi za kati, ambazo kwa kawaida huisha karibu na mwaka wa 1500.

source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
reference: Uainishaji wa kiufundi ni kishazi ambacho hujumuisha maoni anuai katika mazoezi, kutoka teknolojia shinikizi, au maendeleo ya kiteknolojia katika dhana kuwa hatma ya binadamu huendeshwa na mantiki ya msingi inayohusishwa na sheria za kisayansi na udhihirisho wake katika teknolojia.
hypothesis: Uamuzi wa kiteknolojia ni neno ambalo linajumuisha aina mbalimbali za mawazo katika mazoezi, kutoka kwa teknolojia ya kushinikiza au umuhimu wa kiteknolojia kwa maana kali kwamba hatima ya binadamu inaongozwa na nadharia ya msingi inayohusishwa na sheria za kisayansi na kuonekana kwao katika teknolojia.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
reference: Tafsiri nyingi za udhibitisho wa kiteknolojia zinashirikisha maoni mawili ya jumla: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe hufuata njia zaidi ya ushawishi wa kitamaduni au kisiasa, na teknolojia hiyo kwa upande ina "athari" kwa jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya hali ya kijamii.
hypothesis: Tafsiri nyingi za utaratibu wa kiteknolojia zinashiriki mawazo mawili ya jumla: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe hufuata njia ambayo huzidi sana ushawishi wa kitamaduni au kisiasa, na kwamba teknolojia kwa upande wake ina "matokeo" juu ya jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya masharti ya kijamii.

source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
reference: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba motokaa hupelekea ukuzaji wa barabara.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba magari ya magari huongoza kwa lazima kwenye maendeleo ya barabara.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa kitaifa wa barabara hufai kiuchumi kwa magari machache tu, kwa hivyo mbinu mpya za uzalishaji zinakuzwa ili kupunguza gharama ya umiliki wa magari.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya magari machache tu, barabara za nchi nzima haziwezi kutumiwa kiuchumi, njia mpya za kutengeneza magari zinatengenezwa ili kupunguza gharama za kuuza magari.

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Umiliki wa magari kwa wingi pia hupelekea matukio mengi ya ajali za barabarani, ambazo hupelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika matibabu za kutengeneza miili iliyovunjika.
hypothesis: Umati wa watu wenye magari pia huleta ongezeko kubwa la ajali barabarani, na hilo huongoza kwenye uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika huduma ya afya za kurekebisha miili iliyoharibiwa.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Uroma ulikuwa na kipengele kikubwa cha maamuzi ya kitamaduni yaliyochochewa na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.
hypothesis: Upendo ulikuwa na sehemu kubwa ya utamaduni wa utamu, uliochukuliwa kutoka kwa waandishi kama Goethe, Fichte, na Schlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Katika muktadha wa Uroma, jiografia ilifinyanga watu, na kwa mpito wa wakati mila na tamaduni zilizohusiana na jiografia zilizuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na hali ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizolazimishwa kiholela.
hypothesis: Katika mazingira ya Kiromantiki, jiografia iliwafinyanga watu, na baada ya muda desturi na utamaduni unaohusiana na jiografia hiyo uliibuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na mahali pa jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizowekwa kwa hiari.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Jinsi Paris inavyojulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo wa ulimwengu wa kisasa, Konstantinople ilichukuliwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo wa Uropa ya kikabaila.
hypothesis: Kwa njia ambayo Paris inajulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo ya ulimwengu wa kisasa, Constantinople ilionwa kama mji mkuu wa mitindo ya Ulaya ya feudal.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Inajulikana kwa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza takribani 400 A.D. na ilidumu hadi karibu 1100 A.D.
hypothesis: Utukufu wake wa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ulianza mwaka wa 400 W.K. na uliendelea hadi mwaka wa 1100 W.K.

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Hali yake ilizorota wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapambanaji wa kidini walikuwa wamerejea na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo vilivyokuwa na thamani ya juu kuliko vile vilivyotolewa na masoko ya Bizanti.
hypothesis: Hali yake ilipungua katika karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba wapanda-kristo walirudi wakiwa na zawadi kama vile hariri na vikolezo ambavyo vilikuwa vikiwa na thamani zaidi kuliko kile masoko ya Byzantine yalivyotoa.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Ilikuwa wakati huu ambapo uhamisho wa Jiji la Mtindo kutoka Konstantinopo hadi Parisi ulifanyika.
hypothesis: Wakati huohuo, jina la Mji Mkuu wa Mtindo lilihamishwa kutoka Constantinople hadi Paris.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Staili ya Kigothi ilifikia kilele katika kipindi kati ya karne za 10-11 na karne ya 14.
hypothesis: Mtindo wa Gothic ulifikia kilele chake katika kipindi kati ya karne ya 10 - 11 na karne ya 14.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Hapo mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa na tamaduni za Baizantini kutoka mashariki.
hypothesis: Mwanzoni, mavazi ya watu yaliguswa sana na utamaduni wa Byzantium mashariki.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia hafifu za mawasiliano, mitindo ya magharibi ilibakia nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia za mawasiliano polepole, mitindo ya magharibi inaweza kuwa nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa Zama za Kati Uropa magharibi ilianza kuendeleza staili yao wenyewe. Mojawapo ya maendeleo makubwa zaidi ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya krusedi watu walianza kutumia vifungo kukazia nguo.
hypothesis: Mwishoni mwa karne ya kati Ulaya Magharibi alianza kuendeleza mtindo wao wenyewe. moja ya maendeleo makubwa ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya vita vya msalaba watu walianza kutumia vifungo kufunga nguo.

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa kwa uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha tu kukimu mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.
hypothesis: Kilimo cha kujitegemea ni kilimo kinachofanywa kwa ajili ya uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha kutosheleza mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni mfumo rahisi, aghalabu wa kikaboni, unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa na asilia kwa eneo husika, pamoja na mzunguko wa mimea au mbinu mbadala zilizo rahisi ili kuboresha mavuno.
hypothesis: Kilimo cha kuishi ni mfumo rahisi, mara nyingi wa kikaboni, kwa kutumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa za asili ya mkoa wa mazingira pamoja na mzunguko wa mazao au mbinu zingine rahisi za kuongeza mavuno.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walijihusisha na kilimo cha kujikimu na hii bado ndiyo hali katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea.
hypothesis: Katika historia wakulima wengi walifanya kazi ya kilimo cha kuishi na bado ndivyo ilivyo katika nchi nyingi zinazoendelea.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Utamaduni mdogo huwaleta pamoja watu walio wa mafikira sawa na ambao wanahisi kuwa wametengwa na viwango vya kijamii na kuwaruhusu kuendeleza hisia za utambulisho.
hypothesis: Utamaduni mbalimbali huleta pamoja watu wenye nia kama yao ambao huhisi wamelalaumiwa na viwango vya jamii na huwawezesha kusitawisha utambulisho.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Vikundi vidogo vya tamaduni vinaweza kuwa vya kipekee kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, daraja, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki.
hypothesis: Subcultures inaweza kuwa tofauti kwa sababu ya umri, kikabila, darasa, eneo, na / au jinsia ya wanachama.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Sifa zinazofanya utamaduni mdogo kuwa wa kipekee huenda zikawa za kilugha, kiurembo, kidini, kisiasa, kijiografia au mchanganyiko wa vipengele.
hypothesis: Sifa zinazoamua utamaduni mmoja kuwa tofauti zinaweza kuwa lugha, aesthetics, dini, kisiasa, ngono, kijiografia, au mchanganyiko wa mambo.

source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Wanachama wa utamaduni mdogo mdogo kwa mara nyingi huashiria uanachama wao kupitia mitindo ya kipekee ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo ya kimavazi, tabia na lugha.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi washiriki wa utamaduni wa chini huonyesha kuwa wanachama wao kupitia matumizi ya kipekee na ya kitamathali ya mtindo, ambayo inajumuisha mitindo, tabia, na utaratibu.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Mojawapo ya mbinu maarufu zinatozumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana ni kutumia mifano michache sikitishi ya watoto ambao, kupitia mapuuza, mikosi, kunyanyaswa kimakusudi, hawakushirikishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wanapokua.
hypothesis: Njia moja ya kawaida zaidi ya kuonyesha umuhimu wa kuungana na watu ni kutumia visa vichache vya watoto ambao, kwa sababu ya kutojali, msiba, au unyanyasaji wa kimakusudi, hawakuunganishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wakikua.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Watoto kama hao huitwa "katili" au jeuri. Watoto wengine katili wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika hali nyingine huu kuachwa kwa watoto kulitokana na wazazi kukataa upungufu mkubwa wa kiakili au mwili kwa mtoto.
hypothesis: Watoto hao huitwa "wanyama" au wanyama. Watoto wengine wanyama wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika visa vingine watoto hao waliachwa kwa sababu wazazi walikataa udhaifu mkubwa wa kiakili au kimwili wa mtoto.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Huenda watoto wasiotagusana walipitia unyanyasaji mkuu au kiwewe utotoni mwao kabla ya kuachiliwa au kutoroka.
hypothesis: Watoto wa mwituni wanaweza kuwa wametendewa vibaya sana au kupatwa na majeraha kabla ya kuachwa au kukimbia.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Wengine wanadaiwa kulewa na wanyama; wengine wanasemekana kuishi porini kivyao.
hypothesis: Wengine wanadai kwamba walilelewa na wanyama; wengine wanasema kwamba waliishi nyikani wakiwa peke yao.
