source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
reference: Uandishi blogi pia "hulazimisha wanafunzi kuwa wajuzi wa ulimwengu unaowazunguka." Hitaji la kutosheleza ari ya hadhira huwachochea wanafunzi kuwa werevu na wenye kuvutia (Toto, 2004).
hypothesis: Pia, kublogi "kunawafanya wanafunzi wawe na ujuzi zaidi kuhusu ulimwengu unaowazunguka".

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
reference: Uandishi blogi ni kifaa kinachochochea ushirikiano, na kuhimiza wanafunzi kupanua usomaji zaidi ya siku ya kawaida ya masomo shuleni.
hypothesis: Kuandika blogu ni chombo ambacho huchochea ushirikiano, na huwatia moyo wanafunzi kupanua kujifunza zaidi ya siku ya jadi ya shule.

source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
reference: Utumiaji mwafaka wa blogu “unaweza kuwawezesha wanafunzi kuwa wachambuzi na wa kushutumu zaidi; kupitia kujibu nyenzo za Intaneti kiamilifu, wanafunzi wanaweza kuaini nafasi zao katika muktadha wa maandiko ya wengine vilevile kuelezea mitazamo yao wenyewe kuhusu masuala maalum (Oravec, 2002).
hypothesis: Matumizi sahihi ya blogi "inaweza kuwawezesha wanafunzi kuwa wachambuzi zaidi na wakosoaji; kwa kujibu kwa bidii kwa vifaa vya mtandao, wanafunzi wanaweza kuamua msimamo wao katika muktadha wa maandishi ya wengine na pia kuelezea maoni yao wenyewe juu ya masuala maalum (Oravec, 2002).

source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
reference: Ottawa na jij la Kanada linalovutia na la jozilugha, na huwa na msururu wa vyumba vya sanaa na nyumba za maonyesho zinazosheheni historia ya Kanada ya zamani na ya sasa.
hypothesis: Ottawa ni mji mkuu wenye kuvutia na wenye lugha mbili wa Kanada na una makumbusho mengi ya sanaa na makumbusho yanayoonyesha historia na wakati wa sasa wa Kanada.

source: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
reference: Mbali zaidi upande wa kusini ni Maporomoko ya Maji ya Niagara na upande wa kaskazini ni kiini cha urembo usiyofichwa cha Muskoka na zaidi.
hypothesis: Mbali zaidi kusini ni Mto Niagara Falls na kaskazini ni makao ya uzuri wa asili usio na kina wa Muskoka na zaidi.

source: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
reference: Mambo haya yote na mengi zaidi huonyesha Ontario kama inavyochukuliwa kiasili kama Kikanada na watu wa nje.
hypothesis: Mambo hayo yote na mengine mengi huonyesha Ontario kama kile ambacho kinachukuliwa kuwa kikuu cha Canada na watu wa nje.

source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
reference: Maeneo mapana upande wa juu wa kaskazini hayana idadi kubwa ya watu na baadhi yake nyika isiyokuwa na watu.
hypothesis: Eneo kubwa zaidi kaskazini lina watu wachache sana na sehemu fulani ni jangwa lisilo na watu.

source: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
reference: Kwa ulinganisho wa idadi ya watu unaowaajabisha wengi: kuna Waafrika Wamarekani wengi wanaoishi Marekani kuliko raia wa Kanada.
hypothesis: Kwa kulinganisha idadi ya watu ambayo inashangaza wengi: Kuna Waafrika wengi zaidi wanaokaa Marekani kuliko kuna raia wa Canada.

source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
reference: Visiwa vya Afrika Mashariki vimo katika Bahari ya Hindi karibu na pwani ya mashariki ya Afrika.
hypothesis: Visiwa vya Afrika Mashariki viko katika Bahari ya Hindi pwani ya mashariki mwa Afrika.

source: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
reference: Madagaska ndiyo kubwa tena kwa mbali, na bara lilojisimamia, ikifikia ni suala la wanyamapori.
hypothesis: Madagaska ni kubwa zaidi, na bara lenyewe linapokuja wanyama wa pori.

source: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
reference: Vingi vya visiwa vidogo ni mataifa huru, au vinahusishwa na Ufaransa, na vinajulikana kama vituo vya mapumziko vya pwani.
hypothesis: Visiwa vingi vidogo ni nchi huru, au vinahusiana na Ufaransa, na vinajulikana kama viwanja vya kupumzika vya pwani vya kifahari.

source: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
reference: Waarabu pia walileta Uislamu katika maeneo, na iliathiri sana Komoros na Mayote.
hypothesis: Waarabu pia walileta dini ya Kiislamu katika nchi hizo, na ilienea sana katika Visiwa vya Comoros na Mayotte.

source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
reference: Ushawishi wa Ulaya na ukoloni ulianza katika karne ya 15, wakati mvumbuzi wa Ureno Vasco da Gama alipopata njia Cape kutoka Ulaya kwenda India.
hypothesis: Ushawishi na ukoloni wa Ulaya ulianza katika karne ya 15, wakati mvumbuzi Mportuguese Vasco da Gama alipoona Njia ya Cape kutoka Ulaya hadi India.

source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Mkoa huo umefungwa na Saheli katika upande wa kaskazini, na umefungwa na Bahari ya Atlantiki katika upande wa kusini na magharibi.
hypothesis: Kaskazini, eneo hilo linazingirwa na Bahari ya Sahel, na kusini na magharibi na Bahari ya Atlantiki.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Wanawake: inapendekezwa kuwa wasafiri wowote wa kike waseme kwamba wameolewa, licha ya hali yao halisi ya ndoa.
hypothesis: Wanawake: Inashauriwa kwamba wanawake wowote wanaosafiri waseme kwamba wameolewa, bila kujali hali yao ya kimwili.

source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
reference: Ni muhimu pia kuvalia pete (wala si inayoonekana ghali sana).
hypothesis: Ni jambo la hekima pia kuvaa pete (si ile tu inayoonekana kuwa ghali sana.

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Wanawake wanapaswa kutambua kuwa tofauti za kitamaduni zinaweza kusababisha kile wangechukulia kama unyanyasaji na ni sio jambo lisilo la kawaida kufuatwa, kunyakuliwa kwa mkono, nk.
hypothesis: Wanawake wanapaswa kutambua kwamba tofauti za kitamaduni zinaweza kusababisha kile ambacho wangeona kuwa mateso na si jambo la kawaida kuandamana, kukamatwa kwa mkono, nk.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Kuwa imara katika kuwakatalia watu, na usiogope kushikilia msimamo wako (tofauti za kitamaduni au la, hazilifanyi kuwa sawa!).
hypothesis: Uwe imara katika kukataza wanaume, na usiogope kusimama imara (tofauti za kitamaduni au la, sivyo inavyofanya iwe sawa!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Jiji la sasa la Kasablanka lilianzishwa na wavuvi wa Berber katika karne ya 10 kabla ya Masihi, na lilitumiwa na Wafoenisi, Warumi, na Wamerenidi kama bandari ya mikakati iliyojulikana kama Anfa.
hypothesis: Jiji la kisasa la Casablanca lilianzishwa na wavuvi wa Berber katika karne ya 10 KK, na lilitumiwa na Wafoinike, Waroma, na Wamareni kama bandari ya kimkakati inayoitwa Anfa.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: Wareno waliiharibu na kuijenga tena chini ya jina Casa Branca, lakini wakaiacha baada ya tetemeko la ardhi mnamo 1755.
hypothesis: Wareno waliiharibu na kuijenga upya chini ya jina Casa Branca, lakini wakaiacha baada ya tetemeko la ardhi mwaka wa 1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Sultani wa Moroko alijenga mji upya kama Daru I-Badya na ukapewa jina la Kasablanka na wafanyabiashara wa Kihispani ambao walianzisha vituo vya biashara huko.
hypothesis: Sultan wa Morocco alijenga upya mji huo kama Daru l-Badya na ulipewa jina Casablanca na wafanyabiashara wa Uhispania ambao walianzisha misingi ya biashara huko.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: Kasablanka ni mojawapo ya mahali pa kuvutia kidogo zaidi kununua vitu katika Moroko yote.
hypothesis: Casablanca ni mojawapo ya maeneo yasiyo ya kuvutia zaidi ya kununua vitu katika Morocco yote.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Karibu na Madina ya zamani ni rahisi kupata sehemu zinazouza bidhaa za kitamaduni za Moroko, kama vile tagines, ufinyanzi, bidhaa za ngozi, ndoano, na wigo mzima wa geegaws, lakini yote ni kwa ajili ya watalii.
hypothesis: Karibu na Medina ya zamani ni rahisi kupata maeneo ya kuuza bidhaa za jadi za Morocco, kama vile tagines, udongo, bidhaa za ngozi, hookah, na aina nzima ya geegaws, lakini yote ni kwa ajili ya watalii.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: Goma ni mji wa kitalii wa Jamburi ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo ulioko mashariki uliokithiri karibu na Rwanda.
hypothesis: Goma ni mji wa watalii wa Jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Kongo mashariki mbali karibu na Rwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Mnamo 2002, Goma iliharibiwa na lava kutoka kwa volkano ya Nyiragongo iliyofunika mingi ya mitaa ya mji, hususan katikati ya mji.
hypothesis: Mnamo 2002 Goma iliharibiwa na lava kutoka volkano ya Nyiragongo ambayo ilizika mitaa mingi ya mji, haswa katikati ya mji.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Japo kwa kiwango kizuri Goma ni salama, ziara zozote nje ya Goma zinapaswa kuchunguzwa ili kufahamu hali ya mapigano yanayoendelea katika jimbo la Kaskazini mwa Kivu.
hypothesis: Wakati Goma ni salama, ziara yoyote nje ya Goma inapaswa kuchunguzwa ili kuelewa hali ya mapigano ambayo yanaendelea katika mkoa wa North Kivu.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Jiji hilo pia ndio msingi wa kukwea volkano ya Nyiragongo pamoja na njia rahisi kabisa za kufuatilia Gorilla wa Milimani barani Afrika.
hypothesis: Jiji hilo pia ni msingi wa kupanda volkano ya Nyiragongo pamoja na baadhi ya ndege za bei rahisi zaidi za kufuatilia wanyama wa kijani huko Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Unaweza kutumia boda-boda (teksi ya pikipiki) kuzunguka Goma. Nauli ya kawaida kwa wenyeji ni Franki 500 za Kongo kwa safari fupi.
hypothesis: Unaweza kutumia boda-boda (taxi ya pikipiki) kuzunguka Goma. Bei ya kawaida (ya ndani) ni ~ 500 Francs za Kongo kwa safari fupi.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Pamoja na kutofikika kwake kwa wastani, “Timbuktu” imekuja kutumika kama sitiari ya nchi za kigeni zilizo mbali sana.
hypothesis: Pamoja na kutokuwa na ufikiaji, "Timbuktu" imetumiwa kama mfano wa nchi za kigeni na za mbali.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Leo hii, Timbuktu ni mji maskini, ingawa sifa zake huufanya kivutio cha watalii, na pia kuna uwanja wa ndege.
hypothesis: Leo, Timbuktu ni mji maskini, ingawa sifa yake hufanya iwe kivutio cha watalii, na ina uwanja wa ndege.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Mnamo 1990, uliongezwa katika orodha ya maeneo ya urithi duniani yaliyo hatarini, kwa sababu ya tishio la mchanga wa jangwani.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1990, iliongezwa kwenye orodha ya maeneo ya urithi wa dunia yenye hatari, kwa sababu ya tishio la mchanga wa jangwa.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Ilikuwa mojawapo ya vituo vikuu wakati wa Maajabu ya Dunia ya Kiafrika spesheli ya PBS ya Henry Louis Gates..
hypothesis: Ilikuwa mojawapo ya vituo vikuu wakati wa kipindi cha pekee cha PBS cha Henry Louis Gates cha Maajabu ya Ulimwengu wa Afrika.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: Jiji hilo liko katika ulinganishi mgumu na miji mingine ya nchi, kwa sababu lina wangavu zaidi wa Kiarabu kuliko ule wa Kiafrika.
hypothesis: Jiji hilo linatofautiana sana na majiji mengine ya nchi hiyo, kwa sababu lina ladha ya Kiarabu kuliko ya Kiafrika.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Kruger (KNP) iko kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika Kusini na inapakana na Msumbiji upande wa mashariki, Zimbabwe upande wa kaskazini, na Mto wa Mamba upande wa kusini.
hypothesis: Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Kruger (KNP) iko kaskazini mashariki mwa Afrika Kusini na inaenea kando ya mpaka wa Msumbiji mashariki, Zimbabwe kaskazini, na mpaka wa kusini ni Mto Crocodile.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Mbuga hiyo inachukua kilomita 19,500 mraba na imegawanywa katika maeneo 14 tofauti ya ekolojia , kila moja ikisaidia wanyama tofauti wa porini.
hypothesis: Hifadhi inashughulikia kilomita 19,5002 na imegawanywa katika maeneo 14 tofauti ya mazingira, kila moja inayounga mkono wanyama tofauti.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Ni mojawapo ya vivutio vya Afrika Kusini na huzingatiwa kuwa kuu kati ya Mbuga za Kitaifa za Afrika Kusini (SANParks).
hypothesis: Ni moja ya vivutio kuu vya Afrika Kusini na inachukuliwa kuwa kilele cha Visiwa vya Kitaifa vya Afrika Kusini (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Kama ilivyo na Mbuga zote za Wanyama za Kitaifa Kusini mwa Afrika, kuna malipo ya kila siku ya uhifadhi na kiingilio.
hypothesis: Kama ilivyo na Hifadhi zote za Kitaifa za Afrika Kusini, kuna uhifadhi wa kila siku na ada ya kuingia kwa Hifadhi.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Inaweza kuwa manufaa kwa mtu kununua Kadi Mbugani, ambayo hutoa kiingilio kwa baadhi ya mbuga za Afrika Kusini au Mbuga zote za Kitaifa za Afrika Kusini.
hypothesis: Pia inaweza kuwa na manufaa kwa mtu kununua Wild Card, ambayo hutoa kuingia ama uchaguzi wa mbuga katika Afrika Kusini au zote za Afrika Kusini National Parks.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Kisiwa cha Hong Kong hulipatia eneo la Hong Kong jina lake na ni mahali ambapo watalii wengi huangazia sana.
hypothesis: Kisiwa cha Hong Kong kinaita eneo la Hong Kong jina lake na ni mahali ambapo watalii wengi huona kuwa mahali pa msingi.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Msururu wa majengo yanayojenga wingu la Hong Kong umeoanishwa na chati ya baa inayopendeza na ambayo yamkini imeundwa kwa uwepo wa maji ya Bandari ya Viktoria.
hypothesis: Mkutano wa majengo yanayoonyesha eneo la Hong Kong umelinganishwa na picha ya bar yenye kung'aa inayoonekana wazi kutokana na maji ya Bandari ya Victoria.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Ili kujionea Hong Kong vizuri zaidi, ondoka kiswani kisha uelekee upande wa mwambao wa Kowloon ulio mkabala.
hypothesis: Ili kupata maoni mazuri zaidi ya Hong Kong, ondoka kisiwa hicho na uende kwenye pwani ya Kowloon iliyo upande wa pili.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Mengi ya maendeleo ya mji ya Visiwa vya Hong Kong yamesongamana katika ardhi iliyorejeshwa katika ufuo wa kaskazini.
hypothesis: Sehemu kubwa ya jiji la Hong Kong liko katika maeneo yaliyochukuliwa upya kwenye pwani ya kaskazini.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Hapa ndipo mahali wakoloni wa Kiingereza walichukulia kuwa pao na kwa hivyo kama unatafuta ushahidi wa zama za kikoloni wa eneo, hapa ni mahali pazuri pa kuanza.
hypothesis: Hii ni mahali ambapo wakoloni wa Uingereza walichukua kama wao wenyewe na hivyo kama wewe ni kuangalia kwa ushahidi wa eneo la makoloni ya zamani, hii ni mahali nzuri ya kuanza.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sandabani ndizo mikoko mikubwa zaidi ya ukanda wa pwani duniani, yenye urefu wa kilomita 80 (maili 50) ndani ya Bangladeshi na bara ya Indi kutoka pwani.
hypothesis: Sundarbans ni ukanda mkubwa wa mangrove wa pwani ulimwenguni, unaenea kilomita 80 (50 mi) hadi nchi za ndani za Bangladesh na India kutoka pwani.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: Sandarbans imetangazwa kuwa Eneo la Urithi wa Dunia la UNESCO. Sehemu ya msitu ndani ya wilaya ya India inaitwa Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Sandarbans.
hypothesis: Sundarbans imewekwa kuwa Urithi wa Dunia wa UNESCO. Sehemu ya msitu ndani ya eneo la India inaitwa Sundarbans National Park.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Misitu hiyo si mikoko ya mabwawa tu - inajumuisha baadhi ya misitu mikuu iliyosalia ambayo kwa wakati mmoja ilikuwa imefunikwa na tambarare ya Gaengitiki.
hypothesis: Misitu si tu mangrove matope ingawa  wao ni pamoja na baadhi ya mabaki ya mwisho ya misitu yenye nguvu ambayo wakati mmoja kufunika Ganga barafu.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarban zimo katika eneo la kilomita 3,850 mraba, ambapo theluthi moja imefunikwa kwa maji/kinamasi.
hypothesis: Sundarbans inashughulikia eneo la 3,850 km2, ambayo karibu theluthi moja ni kufunikwa na maji / maeneo ya matope.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Tangu mwaka wa 1966 Sandabani zimekuwa mbuga za wanyama pori, na inakadiriwa kuwa sasa kuna chui 400 wa Royal Bengal na kulungu takribani 30,000 katika eneo hilo.
hypothesis: Tangu mwaka wa 1966 maeneo ya Sundarbans yamekuwa makao ya wanyama wa pori, na inakadiriwa kwamba sasa kuna simbamarara 400 wa Kifalme wa Bengal na karibu dubu 30,000 wenye madoa katika eneo hilo.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Mabasi huondoka kituo cha basi cha kati ya mawilaya (upande mwingine wa mto) siku nzima, ingawa mengi, haswa yale yanaoelekea mashariki na Jakar / Bumthang huondoka kati ya saa 6 na dakika 30 na saa 7 na dakika 30.
hypothesis: Mabasi huondoka kituo cha basi cha wilaya (kwenye mto) siku nzima, ingawa wengi, haswa wale wanaokwenda mashariki na Jakar / Bumthang huondoka kati ya 06:30 na 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Kwa kuwa mara nyingi mabasi yanayounganisha wilaya huwa yamejaa, inashauriwa kununua tikiti siku kadhaa mapema.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa mabasi ya wilaya mbalimbali huwa yamejaa, ni vyema kununua tiketi siku chache mapema.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Wilaya nyingi huhudumiwa na Mabasi madogo ya Pwani ya Kijapani, ambayo ni ya starehe na imara.
hypothesis: Wilaya nyingi hutumikiwa na Mabasi madogo ya pwani ya Japani, ambayo ni yenye starehe na yenye nguvu.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Teksi zilizoshirikiwa ni aina haraka na starehe ya kusafiri katika maeneo ya karibu, kama vile Paro (Nu 150) na Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Teksi za pamoja ni njia ya haraka na ya starehe ya kusafiri kwenda maeneo ya karibu, kama vile Paro (Nu 150) na Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Daraja la Mto wa Oyapock ni daraja lililokaa kwa waya. Linatoka Mto Oyapock na kuunganisha miji ya Oiapoque nchini Brazil na Saint-Georges de I’Oyapock iliyo Guiana ya Ufaransa.
hypothesis: Daraja la Mto Oyapock ni daraja la cable-stayed. Inaenea Mto Oyapock kuunganisha miji ya Oiapoque nchini Brazil na Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock nchini Guiana ya Ufaransa.

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Minara hiyo miwili inainuka hadi urefu wa mita 83, ina urefu wa mita 378 na ina leni mbili zenye upana wa mita 3.50.
hypothesis: Mnara huo una urefu wa mita 83, urefu wa mita 378 na pana ya mita 3.50

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: Kibali cha wima chini ya daraja ni mita 15. Ujenzi ulikamilika mnamo Agosti 2011, haikufunguliwa kwa trafiki hadi Machi 2017.
hypothesis: Uwazi wa umeme chini ya daraja ni mita 15. Ujenzi ulimalizika Agosti 2011, haukufunguliwa kwa trafiki hadi Machi 2017.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
reference: Daraja limeratibiwa kufanya kazi kikamilifu mnamo Septemba 2017, wakati vituo vya ukaguzi wa forodha vya Kibrazili vinatarajiwa kukamilishwa.
hypothesis: Daraja hilo linatarajiwa kufanywa kazi kikamilifu mnamo Septemba 2017, wakati vituo vya ukaguzi vya forodha vya Brazil vinatarajiwa kukamilika.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Waguaraní walikuwa kundi lenye maana zaidi ambalo linakaa kule ambako sasa kunaitwa Paragwai Mashariki, wakiishi kama wawindaji wahamahama ambao pia walikuwa wakilima mazao ya kujikimu.
hypothesis: Wa Guarani walikuwa kikundi muhimu zaidi cha wenyeji wanaoishi katika eneo ambalo sasa ni Mashariki mwa Paraguay, wakiishi kama wawindaji wa nusu-wahamiaji ambao pia walifanya kilimo cha kuishi.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Eneo la Chako lilikuwa nyumbani mwa vikundi vingine vya kienyeji kama vile Guaycurú na Payaguá, ambao waliishi kwa uwindaji, ukusanyaji na uvuvi.
hypothesis: Mkoa wa Chaco ulikuwa makao ya vikundi vingine vya makabila ya wenyeji kama vile Guaycurú na Payaguá, ambao waliishi kwa kuwinda, kukusanya na kuvua samaki.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Katika karne ya 16, Parague, iliyojulikana awali kama "Jitu la Mkoa wa Indi", ilizaliwa kufuatia makabiliano kati ya washindi wa Kihispania na makundi asilia.
hypothesis: Katika karne ya 16, Paraguay, ambayo hapo awali iliitwa "Mkoa Mkubwa wa India", ilizaliwa kutokana na kukutana kwa washindi Wahispania na vikundi vya wenyeji wa asili.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Wahispania walianza kipindi cha ukoloni ambacho kilidumu kwa karne tatu.
hypothesis: Wahispania walianza kipindi cha ukoloni kilichodumu kwa karne tatu.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Tangu msingi wa Asuncion mnamo 1537, Paraguai imeweza kudumisha sifa na utambulisho wake wa kienyeji.
hypothesis: Tangu kuanzishwa kwa Asunción mwaka wa 1537, Paraguay imeweza kudumisha tabia na utambulisho wake wa wenyeji.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Ajentina inajulikana vizuri kwa kuwa na mojawapo ya timu na wachezaji bora wa polo ulimweguni.
hypothesis: Argentina inajulikana kwa kuwa na mojawapo ya timu bora za polo na wachezaji ulimwenguni.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Mchuano mkubwa zaidi wa mwaka utafanyika mnamo Desemba kwenye nyanja za polo katika Las Kanitas.
hypothesis: Mashindano makubwa zaidi ya mwaka hufanyika Desemba katika uwanja wa polo huko Las Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Michuano na mechi ndogo zinaweza pia kuonekana kutoka hapa katika nyakati nyingine za mwaka.
hypothesis: Michuano na mechi ndogo zaidi zinaweza pia kuonekana hapa wakati mwingine wa mwaka.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Kwa habari kuhusu michuano na mahali pa kununua tikiti za mechi za polo, angalia Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: Kwa habari kuhusu mashindano na wapi kununua tiketi za mechi za polo, angalia Asociación Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Sarafu rasmi ya Falkilandi ni pauni ya Falkilandi (FKP) ambayo thamani yake inakadiriwa kuwa sawa na ile pauni moja ya Uingereza (GBP).
hypothesis: Fedha rasmi ya Falklands ni Falkland pound (FKP) ambayo thamani yake imewekwa sawa na ya pauni moja ya Uingereza (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Pesa zinaweza kubadilishwa katika benki ya pekee visiwani ambayo inapatikana Stanley mkabala na duka la FIC West.
hypothesis: Pesa zinaweza kubadilishwa katika benki pekee katika visiwa ambayo iko katika Stanley mbele ya duka FIC West.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Kwa jumla pauni za Uingereza zitakubaliwa mahali popote katika visiwa, na ndani ya Stanley kadi za mikopo na dola za Marekani pia hukubaliwa mara nyingi.
hypothesis: Pound za Uingereza kwa ujumla zitakubaliwa mahali popote katika visiwa na ndani ya kadi za mkopo za Stanley na dola za Marekani pia mara nyingi zinakubaliwa.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Katika visiwa vya nje kadi za mkopo huenda zisikubalike, ingawa pesa za Uingereza na Amerika zinaweza kuchukuliwa; angalia na wamiliki mapema ili kujua ni njia gani ya malipo inayokubalika.
hypothesis: Katika visiwa vilivyo mbali, huenda kadi za mkopo zisipokee, ingawa huenda ikawa fedha za Uingereza na Marekani zikichukuliwa; tafuta mapema na wamiliki ili uone ni njia gani ya malipo inayoweza kukubaliwa.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Haiwezekani kubadilishana sarafu ya Falkland nje ya visiwa, kwa hivyo badilisha pesa kabla ya kuondoka kwenye visiwa.
hypothesis: Ni vigumu kubadilishana sarafu za Falkland nje ya visiwa hivyo kubadilishana pesa kabla ya kuondoka visiwa.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Kwa kuwa Montevideo imo kusini mwa Ikweta, huko huwa ni msimu wa kiangazi wakati Nyanda ya Kaskazini ni baridi na kinyume chake.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa Montevideo iko kusini mwa Ikweta, ni majira ya kiangazi huko wakati ni majira ya baridi kali katika Nusu ya Dunia na kinyume chake.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo iko upande wa sabutropiki; katika miezi ya kiangazi, hali ya joto zaidi ya +30ºC ni hali ya kawaida.
hypothesis: Montevideo iko katika maeneo ya kitropiki; wakati wa majira ya joto, joto zaidi ya nyuzi 30 za Selsiasi ni la kawaida.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Msimu wa baridi unaweza kuwa baridi kidanganyifu: kadiri ya joto kwa mara chache sana huenda chini ya kiwango cha kugandisha, lakini upepo na unyevu huchanganyika na kufanya kuwe na baridi zaidi kuliko ile ambayo kipimajoto kinasema.
hypothesis: Majira ya baridi yanaweza kuwa ya kipumbavu: joto mara chache huanguka chini ya kiwango cha juu, lakini upepo na unyevu huchanganya na kufanya uhisi baridi kuliko kile ambacho thermometer husema.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Hakuna vipindi maalum vya “mvua” au “ukavu”: kiwango cha mvua hubaki takribani sawa mwaka mzima.
hypothesis: Hakuna majira hususa ya "ma mvua" na "ma mvua": kiasi cha mvua kinabaki sawa mwaka mzima.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Ingawa wanyama wengi mbugani wamezoea kuwaona wanadamu, kwa vyovyote wanyapori ni wa mwituni, wala hawastahili kulishwa au kusumbuliwa.
hypothesis: Ingawa wanyama wengi katika bustani wamezoea kuona wanadamu, wanyama hao ni wa pori na hawahitaji kulishwa au kuvurugishwa.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Kwa mujibu wa usimamizi wa mbuga, kaa walau yadi/mita 100 mbali na dubu na mbwa mwitu na yadi/mita 25 kutoka kwa wanyama mwitu wengine wote!
hypothesis: Kulingana na mamlaka ya mbuga, kaa mbali na dubu na mbwa-mwitu angalau mita 100 na wanyama wengine wote wa mwituni mita 25!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Haijalishi jinsi watulivu wanavyokaa, baisani, elki, kongoni, dubu, na karibu wanyama wote wakubwa wanaweza kushambulia.
hypothesis: Hata wawe wanyenyekevu kadiri gani, bisoni, mbuzi, mbuzi, dubu, na karibu wanyama wote wakubwa wanaweza kushambulia.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Kila mwaka, dazeni za wageni huumia kwa sababu hawakuzingatia umbali unaofaa. Wanyama hawa ni wakubwa, wa mwitu, na uwezekano wa kuwa hatari, kwa hivyo wape nafasi yao.
hypothesis: Kila mwaka, wageni wengi hujeruhiwa kwa sababu ya kutokuwa na umbali unaofaa. Wanyama hao ni wakubwa, ni wanyamapori, na wanaweza kuwa hatari, kwa hiyo waacheni waishi.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Kwa kuongezea, fahamu kuwa harufu huwavutia dubu na wanyama wengine mwitu, kwa hivyo epuka kubeba au kupika vyakula vyenye harufu na utunze usafi kwenye kambi.
hypothesis: Pia, kumbuka kwamba harufu huvutia dubu na wanyama wengine wa mwituni, kwa hiyo epuka kubeba au kupika vyakula vyenye harufu nzuri na uendelee kuwa safi.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia ni mji mkuu wa Samoa. Mji huo uko kwenye kisiwa cha Upolu na lina watu chini ya 40,000.
hypothesis: Apia ni mji mkuu wa Samoa, mji ulio kwenye kisiwa cha Upolu na wenyeji wake ni chini ya 40,000.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia ilianzishwa miaka ya 1850 na imekuwa mji mkuu rasmi wa Samoa tangu 1959.
hypothesis: Apia ilianzishwa katika miaka ya 1850 na imekuwa mji mkuu rasmi wa Samoa tangu 1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Bandari ilikuwa sehemu ya kutokabiliana maarufu kwa nevi mnamo 1889 wakati meli saba kutoka Ujerumani, Marekani na Uingereza zilikataa kuondoka kwenye bandari.
hypothesis: Bandari hiyo ilikuwa mahali pa kushindana kwa meli ya kimbunga mwaka wa 1889 wakati meli saba kutoka Ujerumani, Marekani, na Uingereza zilipokataa kuondoka bandari hiyo.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Meli zote zilizamishwa, isipokuwa meli moja ya Uingereza. Karibu maisha 200 ya Wamarekani na Wajerumani yalipotea.
hypothesis: Meli zote zilizama isipokuwa meli moja ya Uingereza, na karibu watu 200 wa Marekani na Wajerumani walipoteza maisha yao.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Wakati wa mapambano ya uhuru yaliyoandaliwa na harakati ya Mau, mkutano wa amani mjini ulisababisha mauaji ya chifu mkuu Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
hypothesis: Wakati wa mapambano ya uhuru yaliyopangwa na harakati ya Mau, mkutano wa amani katika mji huo uliongoza kwa mauaji ya mkuu mkuu Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana na kukaliwa magamaga kwa kwa bandari mbili na Auckland. Maarufu zaidi ziko katika sehemu tatu.
hypothesis: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana Auckland ni overlapping ya bandari mbili. maarufu zaidi ni katika maeneo matatu.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Fukwe za pwani ya Kaskazini (katika wilaya ya Kaskazini mwa Bandari) ziko kwenye Bahari ya Pasifiki na zinyooka kutoka Long Bay kaskazini hadi Devonport kusini.
hypothesis: North Shore fukwe (katika North Harbour wilaya) ni juu ya Bahari ya Pasifiki na kupanuka kutoka Long Bay kaskazini Devonport kusini.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Karibu fukwe zote ni za mchanga na uogeleaji salama na nyingi yake huwa na kivuli chini ya miti ya pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Karibu zote ni fukwe zenye mchanga zenye kuogelea salama, na nyingi zina kivuli kinachoandaliwa na miti ya pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pwani za Tamaki Drive ziko katika Bandari ya Waitemata, kwenye maeneo ya kifahari ya Mission Bay na St. Heliers katika Auckland ya Kati.
hypothesis: Pwani za Tamaki Drive ziko kwenye Bandari ya Waitemata, katika vijiji vya kifahari vya Mission Bay na St Heliers katika Auckland ya Kati.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Hizi ni pwani za kifamilia ambazo wakati mwingine hujaa watu, zilizo na masafa ya maduka katika ufuo. Uogeleaji ni salama.
hypothesis: Nyakati nyingine, maeneo hayo ni ya familia yenye watu wengi na maduka mengi yanatawanyika kando ya pwani.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Bia kuu katika eneo ni ‘Number One’, sio bia tata, ila ni zuri na hufariji. Hio bia nyingine ya mtaa huitwa ‘Manta’.
hypothesis: Kileo kuu la ndani ni 'Namba ya Kwanza', si ngumu bia, lakini ya kufurahisha na kuburudisha.

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Kuna aina nyingi za mvinyo wa Kifaransa inavyopatikana, lakini mvinyo wa New Zealand na Australia waweza safiri bora.
hypothesis: Kuna divai nyingi za Kifaransa za kunywa, lakini divai za New Zealand na Australia zinaweza kusafiri vizuri zaidi.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Maji ya ndani ya bomba ni salama kabisa kwa kunywa, lakini maji ya chupa ni rahisi kupata iwapo una hofu.
hypothesis: Maji ya bomba ya huko ni salama kabisa kunywa, lakini maji yaliyotiwa chupa ni rahisi kupata ikiwa unaogopa.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Kwa Waaustralia, wazo la kahawa ‘nyeupe’ ni la kigeni. Nyeusi fupi ni ’espresso’, cappuccino inakuja imerundikwa zaidi na malai (si povu) na chai inaandaliwa bila maziwa.
hypothesis: Kwa Waaustralia, wazo la kahawa 'nyeupe' ni la kigeni. Nyeusi mfupi ni 'espresso', cappuccino huja juu ya juu na cream (sio povu), na chai hutolewa bila maziwa.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Kinywaji moto cha chokoleti kinafikia viwango vya Ubelgiji. Sharubati za matunda ni bei ghali lakini ni bora.
hypothesis: Chokoleti ya moto hufuata viwango vya Ubelgiji.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Safari nyingi kwenye mwamba hufanywa mwaka mzima, na majeraha kutokana na sababu yoyote baina ya hizi katika mwamba ni nadra.
hypothesis: Safari nyingi za kusafiri kwenye matumbawe hufanywa mwaka mzima, na majeraha yanayosababishwa na yoyote ya sababu hizo kwenye matumbawe hayaonekani mara nyingi.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Bado, chukua ushauri kutoka kwa mamlaka, utii ishara zote, na umakinikie maonyo ya usalama.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, fuata ushauri wa wenye mamlaka, utii ishara zote, na uangalie sana maonyo ya usalama.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Viwavi wa baharini hutokea karibu na pwani na karibu na midomo ya mto kuanzia Oktoba hadi Aprili kaskazini mwa 1770. Wakati mwingine huenda wakapatikana nje ya nyakati hizi.
hypothesis: Mimba ya sanduku huonekana karibu na fukwe na karibu na mito kutoka Oktoba hadi Aprili kaskazini mwa 1770.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Papa wapo, ingawa ni nadra kwao kuwashambulia binadamu. Papa wengi huwaogopa wanadamu na huogelea mbali.
hypothesis: Ingawa samaki wa aina hiyo wako, ni nadra sana kuwashambulia wanadamu, kwa kuwa wengi wao wanaogopa wanadamu na huenda wakaenda zao.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Mamba wa majichumvi hawaishi sana baharini, kwani makazi yao ya kimsingi ni milango ya mito kaskazini mwa Rokihamptoni.
hypothesis: Nguruwe wa maji ya chumvi hawaishi kikamilifu katika bahari, makao yao ya msingi ni katika mito kaskazini mwa Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Kuhifadhi mapema humpatia msafiri amani ya akili kwamba atapata mahali pa kulala atakapofika.
hypothesis: Kuweka kitabu mapema humpa msafiri amani ya akili kwamba atakuwa na mahali pa kulala mara tu watakapowasili mahali wanakwenda.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Kampuni za uwakala wa usafiri mara nyingi huwa na ofa na hoteli maalum, ingawa unaweza kupata uwezekano wa kuhifadhi aina nyingine za malazi, kama mahali pa kupiga kambi, kupitia wakala wa usafiri.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi wakala wa kusafiri wana shughuli na hoteli fulani, ingawa huenda ukaona inawezekana kuweka nafasi za malazi mengine, kama vile maeneo ya kambi, kupitia wakala wa kusafiri.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Kampuni za wakala wa usafiri kwa kawaida hutoa vifurushi vya ofa ambavyo hujumuisha kiamshakinywa, mipango ya uchukuzi kwenda/kutoka kwenye uwanja wa ndege au hata vifurushi vya ndege na hoteli vilivyochanganywa.
hypothesis: Wakala wa kusafiri kwa kawaida kutoa vifurushi ambayo ni pamoja na kifungua kinywa, mipango ya usafiri kwa / kutoka uwanja wa ndege au hata pamoja ndege na hoteli vifurushi.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Pia wanaweza kukuwekea uhifadhi iwapo unahitaji muda wa kufikiria kuhusu ofa hiyo au kupata hati nyingine za mahali unapokwenda (k.m. visa).
hypothesis: Pia wanaweza kuweka nafasi kwa ajili yako ikiwa unahitaji muda wa kufikiria juu ya ofa au kupata hati nyingine kwa ajili ya marudio yako (kwa mfano visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Marekebisho au maombi yoyote lazima yafuatwe kupitia wakala wa kusafiri kwanza na si moja kwa moja na hoteli.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, marekebisho yoyote au maombi yanapaswa kutumwa kwanza kupitia wakala wa kusafiri na si moja kwa moja kwa hoteli.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Kwa baadhi ya tamasha, idadi kubwa ya wanaohudhuria tamasha za muziki huamua kukita kambi kwenye eneo, na wengi wao hukuchukulia kuwa sehemu muhimu ya tajriba hiyo.
hypothesis: Katika sherehe fulani, wengi wa wahudhuriaji wa sherehe za muziki huamua kupiga kambi mahali hapo, na wahudhuriaji wengi huona hilo kuwa sehemu muhimu ya uzoefu.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Ikiwa ungetaka kuwa karibu na matukio utahitajika kurauka mapema ili upate eneo la kukita kambi karibu na muziki.
hypothesis: Kama unataka kuwa karibu na hatua utakuwa na kwenda kupata mapema kupata kambi karibu na muziki.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Kumbuka kuwa hata muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu ukimalizika, kunaweza kuwa na sehemu za tamasha ambazo zitaendelea kucheza muziki hadi usiku wa manane.
hypothesis: Kumbuka kwamba ingawa huenda muziki kwenye majukwaa makuu umekwisha, huenda kukawa na sehemu za sherehe ambazo zitaendelea kucheza muziki mpaka usiku sana.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Tamasha kadhaa zina maeneo maalumu ya kukita kambi kwa familia zenye watoto wadogo.
hypothesis: Katika sherehe fulani kuna maeneo ya pekee ya kupiga kambi kwa ajili ya familia zenye watoto wadogo.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Kama unavuka Northern Baltic katika msimu wa baridi, kagua eneo la kibanda, kwani kupita katika theluji husababisha kelele mbaya kwa wale wanaoathirika zaidi.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unasafiri kupitia Bahari ya Baltic ya Kaskazini wakati wa majira ya baridi kali, angalia mahali ambapo nyumba hiyo iko, kwa kuwa kupita kupitia barafu husababisha kelele mbaya sana kwa wale walioathiriwa zaidi.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Safari za baharini za Mtakatifu Petersburge hujumuisha muda wa mjini. Abiria hawa wameepushwa na mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).
hypothesis: Cruise Saint Petersburg ni pamoja na muda katika mji. abiria cruise ni huru kutoka mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Makasino kwa kawaida hufanya juhudi nyingi ili kuongeza pesa na muda unaotumika na wacheza kamari. Madirisha na saa kwa kawaida huwa hazipo na mlango wa kutoka huwa mgumu kupata.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kasinon hujitahidi sana kutumia wakati na pesa nyingi zaidi kwa ajili ya wageni, kwa kuwa madirisha na saa hazipatikani, na huenda ikawa vigumu kupata njia ya kutoka.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Aghalabu huwa na chakula cha kipekee, vinywaji na matoleo ya burdani, ili kuwatumbuiza wageni na kuwatunza katika majengo yao.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, huwa na chakula, vinywaji, na burudani maalum ili kuwafanya wageni wawe na hali nzuri ya akili na kuwaweka mahali pao.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Baadhi ya kumbi hutoa vileo ndani ya nyumba. Hata hivyo, ulevi hutatiza maamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wazuri wanajua umuhimu wa kuwa watulivu.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ulevi huathiri uamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wanaojua umuhimu wa kukaa macho.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Yeyote ambaye atakuwa akiendesha gari maeneo yaliyoinuka au vijia vya milimani anastahili kuzingatia uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, na baridi kali.
hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayeendesha gari katika latitudo za juu au kupitia milima anapaswa kufikiria uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, au joto kali.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Katika barabara zenye barafu na theluji, msuguano uko chini na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko katika lami tupu.
hypothesis: Katika barabara zenye barafu na theluji, kuna usumbufu mdogo na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko juu ya lami tupu.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Wakati wa barafu nyingi, barafu ya kutosha kukufanya ukwame inaweza kuanguka kwa muda mfupi.
hypothesis: Wakati wa dhoruba za theluji, theluji ya kutosha kukufanya uingie ndani ya muda mfupi sana inaweza kuanguka.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Mwonekano unaweza pia kuzuiliwa kupitia kwa kuanguka au kuvumisha theluji au kwa mtonesho au barafu kwenye madirisha ya magari.
hypothesis: Maono yanaweza pia kupunguzwa kwa sababu ya theluji kuanguka au kupumua au kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa joto au barafu kwenye madirisha ya gari.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Kwa upande mwingine, mazingira ya theluji na barafu ni ya kawaida katika mataifa mengi, na uchukuzi huendelea mwaka mzima bila kutatizwa.
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, hali ya barafu na theluji ni ya kawaida katika nchi nyingi, na trafiki huendelea bila kuvunjika mwaka mzima.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Pengine safari ndizo kivutio kikubwa zaidi cha watalii katika Afrika na angazio la wageni wengi.
hypothesis: Huenda safari ni kituo kikubwa zaidi cha utalii barani Afrika na ni kituo cha kuvutia zaidi kwa wageni wengi.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Neno safari linamaanisha kusafiri kuona Wanyama wa pori wa Afrika wanaoshangaza, haswa kwenye savanna
hypothesis: Neno safari linalotumiwa sana linamaanisha kusafiri kwa nchi kavu ili kuona wanyama-mwitu wa Afrika wenye kuvutia, hasa kwenye savanna.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Baadhi ya wanyama, kama vile ndovu na twiga, huelekea kusogea kukaribia magari na vifaa vya kawaida vitaruhusu utazamaji mwema.
hypothesis: Wanyama fulani, kama vile tembo na girafu, huwa karibu sana na magari na vifaa vya kawaida vitaruhusu kuona vizuri.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Simba, duma na chui wakati mwingine huwa na aibu na utawaona bora na darubini.
hypothesis: Nyoka, cheetahs na chui ni waoga wakati mwingine na utawaona vizuri zaidi kwa kutumia vioo.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Safari ya miguu (ijulikanayo kama "matembezi kichakani", "safari ya kukwea", au kwenda "kwa miguu") hujumuisha ukweaji, iwe kwa saa chache au siku kadhaa.
hypothesis: Safari ya kutembea (pia inaitwa "kutembea kwenye miti", "kutembea safari", au kwenda "kwenda") inatia ndani kutembea, ama kwa saa chache au siku kadhaa.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Mbio za Walemavu zitaanza mnamo Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021. Baadhi ya mashindano yatafanyika katika maeneo tofauti tofauti kote Japani.
hypothesis: Michezo ya Olimpiki itafanyika kutoka Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021. Baadhi ya matukio yatafanyika katika maeneo mengine kote Japani.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo itakuwa mji wa kipekee wa Asia kuwahi kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki mbili za kiangazi, kwani ilikuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo mnamo 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo litakuwa jiji pekee la Asia ambalo limetayarisha Michezo miwili ya Olimpiki ya majira ya joto, baada ya kuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo katika 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Ikiwa ulihifadhi nafasi ya ndege na malazi yako 2020 kabla ya uahirisho kutangazwa, unaweza kuwa na hali ya hila.
hypothesis: Ikiwa ulibadilisha safari yako ya ndege na malazi kwa mwaka 2020 kabla ya kutangaza kuahirishwa, unaweza kuwa na hali ngumu.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Sera za kufuta zinatofautiana, lakini kufikia mwishoni mwa mwezi Machi sera nyingi za ughairi kwa sababu ya virusi vya korona hazifiki hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki ilikuwa imeratibiwa.
hypothesis: Sera za kufutwa zinatofautiana, lakini mwishoni mwa Machi sera nyingi za kufutwa kulingana na coronavirus hazipanuki hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki zilipokuwa zimepangwa.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi nyingi za hafla zitagharimu kati ya Yeni 2,500 na Yeni 130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zikigharimu takriban Yeni 7,000.
hypothesis: Inatarajiwa kuwa tiketi nyingi za hafla zitagharimu kati ya ¥2,500 na ¥130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zitagharimu karibu ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Kupiga pasi nguo zilizo na maji kunaweza kuzisaidia kukauka. Hoteli nyingi zina pasi na bodi za kupigia pasi za kukodisha, hata kama mtu hayuko ndani ya chumba hicho.
hypothesis: Kuweka nguo zenye unyevu kwenye sakafu kunaweza kuwasaidia kuifanya iwe kavu.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Ikiwa pasi haipatikani, au ikiwa hupendii kuvaa soksi zilizopasiwa, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kikaushi nywele, ikiwa kinapatikana.
hypothesis: Ikiwa hakuna chuma cha kuogelea, au ikiwa hupendi kuvaa soksi za kuogelea, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kiogelea cha kuogelea nywele, ikiwa kinaweza kupatikana.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Uwe mwangalifu kitambaa kisiwe moto sana (kwani inaweza kusababisha urukaji, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kuchoma).
hypothesis: Uwe mwangalifu usifanye nguo iwe moto sana (ambayo inaweza kusababisha kufungia, au katika visa vya hatari, kuchoma).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Kuna njia tofauti za kusafisha maji, baadhi zikiwa na mafanikio dhidi ya vitishio maalum.
hypothesis: Kuna njia mbalimbali za kusafisha maji, na baadhi ya njia hizo ni bora zaidi kupambana na vitisho fulani.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Katika baadhi ya maeneo mengine kuchemsha maji kwa dakika moja kunatosha, kwingineko dakika kadhaa zitahitajika.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo fulani maji ya kuchemsha kwa dakika moja yanatosha, katika mengine yanahitaji dakika kadhaa.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Vichujio hutofautiana katika utendaji, na iwapo utapatwa na wasiwasi, basi unafaa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kabisa kutoka kwa kampuni tajika.
hypothesis: Kichujio cha maji kinaweza kuwa na ufanisi mbalimbali, na ikiwa una wasiwasi, basi unapaswa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kutoka kwa kampuni yenye sifa nzuri.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawawatambui kutoka maeneo yao ya nyumbani.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawajui katika maeneo yao ya nyumbani.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Wadudu waharibifu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha maudhi, au katika hali mbaya kusababisha athari za mzio, kueneza sumu au kusambaza maambukizi.
hypothesis: Wadudu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha uchungu, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kusababisha athari za king'ora, kueneza sumu, au kuambukiza maambukizo.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Maradhi yenyewe ya kuambukiza, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawahitimu kama wanyama-vipenzi.
hypothesis: Magonjwa yenye kuambukiza yenyewe, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kuumiza au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawawezi kuwa wadudu.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Ununuzi bila ushuru ni nafasi ya kununua bidhaa zisizo na ushuru na kodi katika maeneo fulani.
hypothesis: Ununuzi wa bure wa ushuru ni fursa ya kununua bidhaa zilizoachiliwa kutoka kwa ushuru na ushuru katika maeneo fulani.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Wasafiri katika nchi zinazotoza ushuru wa juu wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa kiwango kikubwa cha pesa, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vinywaji vyenye vileo na tumbaku.
hypothesis: Wakati mwingine wasafiri wanaosafiri kwenda nchi zenye kodi nyingi wanaweza kuokoa pesa nyingi, hasa kwa ajili ya bidhaa kama vile vileo na tumbaku.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Eneo katikati mwa Point Marion na Fairmont hutoa hali za uendeshaji gari zenye changamoto zaidi katika Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, inayopitia mara kwa mara kwenye maeneo ya ardhi yaliyo katika misitu iliyotengwa.
hypothesis: Mstari kati ya Point Marion na Fairmont unaonyesha hali ngumu zaidi za kuendesha gari kwenye Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, ikipita mara nyingi kupitia eneo la misitu ya mbali.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Kama hujazoea kuendesha gari katika barabara za mashambani, kaa chonjo: miinuko mikali, njia nyembamba, na na pembe kali zimejaa.
hypothesis: Ikiwa hujazoea kuendesha gari barabarani, uwe mwangalifu: barabara zenye barabara nyembamba, barabara nyembamba, na pembe nyembamba huenea.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Viwango vya kasi vilivyotumwa viko chini kabisa kuliko vya sehemu za zamani na zilizofuata — kawaida maili 35-40 kwa saa (kilomita 56-64 kwa saa) — na utii mkali kwavyo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.
hypothesis: Mipaka ya kasi iliyowekwa ni chini sana kuliko katika sehemu zilizopita na za baadaye  kawaida 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)  na utii mkali kwao ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Cha kushangaza hata hivyo, huduma ya simu ya rununu ina nguvu sana hapa kuliko tandaa zingine za njia kama Pennsylvania Wilds.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, jambo la kushangaza ni kwamba huduma ya simu za mkononi ni yenye nguvu zaidi hapa kuliko katika sehemu nyingine nyingi za barabara, kama vile Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.
hypothesis: Matoleo ya Ujerumani ni mazuri sana, na huko Bavaria, ni mengi na ni tofauti-tofauti sana, kama yale ya Austria, jirani yao ya kusini.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.
hypothesis: Matunda ya matunda ni ya kawaida, na maapulo hupikwa kuwa matunda ya matunda mwaka mzima, na vijani na plums huonekana wakati wa majira ya joto.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.
hypothesis: Vyakula vingi vya Ujerumani vina vyakula vya mlo wa mlo vinavyotia ndani mlo wa almond, nzige, na mlo mwingine wa mlo wa mlo.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unataka mikate midogo lakini yenye utajiri, jaribu kile kinachoitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen kulingana na mkoa.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.
hypothesis: Kari ni sahani inayotegemea mimea na vikolezo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.
hypothesis: Kari inaweza kuwa " kavu " au " mvua " kulingana na kiasi cha maji.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo ya ndani ya India Kaskazini na Pakistan, yoghurt hutumiwa kwa kawaida katika curries; katika India Kusini na baadhi ya maeneo mengine ya pwani ya bara, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa kwa kawaida.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa kuna visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, vyakula vya Indonesia ni neno la kawaida linalohusu vyakula mbalimbali vya mkoa vinavyopatikana katika nchi nzima.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.
hypothesis: Lakini, linapotumiwa bila sifa nyingine, neno hilo huwa linamaanisha chakula kilichotoka sehemu za kati na mashariki za kisiwa kikuu cha Java.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.
hypothesis: Sasa, vyakula vya Kijava vinavyopatikana kwa wingi katika kisiwa hicho vyote vina vyakula vingi vilivyochachwa kwa ladha, na ladha kuu ambazo Wajava wanapenda ni maharagwe, chili, sukari (hasa sukari ya nazi ya Kijava) na vikolezo mbalimbali vyenye harufu nzuri.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning’inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.
hypothesis: Vifuko vya kuendesha ni vifungo vya miguu ya mpandaji ambavyo hutegemea upande wa pili wa kiti.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.
hypothesis: Wao kutoa utulivu zaidi kwa mpanda farasi lakini inaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa usalama kutokana na uwezekano wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kupata kukwama katika yao.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.
hypothesis: Ikiwa mpanda farasi anapotupwa kutoka kwenye farasi lakini miguu yake inashikwa kwenye kipande cha mguu, huenda ikavuviwa farasi anapokimbia.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.
hypothesis: Kwanza, wapanda farasi wengi huvaa viatu vya kuendesha na kiatu chenye umbo la mguu na kiatu chenye laini, chenye mwendo mwembamba.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.
hypothesis: Kisha, baadhi ya viti vya kuendesha gari, hasa viti vya Kiingereza, vina vibao vya usalama vinavyowezesha ngozi ya mguu kuanguka kutoka kwenye viti vya kuendesha gari ikiwa inavutwa nyuma na mpanda-farasi anayeanguka.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.
hypothesis: Bonde la Cochamó - Ni mahali pa kwanza nchini Chile kupanda milimani, na huitwa Yosemite ya Amerika Kusini, na kuna kuta na miamba mingi ya granite.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.
hypothesis: Mikutano hiyo ina maoni ya kupendeza kutoka kwenye vilele. Wapanda-mlima kutoka sehemu zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake usio na mwisho wa kuta.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.
hypothesis: Michezo ya kuteleza theluji, kutia ndani ski na snowboard, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya eneo lililofunikwa na theluji na ski au snowboard iliyounganishwa na miguu yako.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.
hypothesis: Skiing ni shughuli kubwa kusafiri na wapenzi wengi, wakati mwingine inajulikana kama "ski bums", kupanga likizo nzima karibu skiing katika eneo fulani.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!
hypothesis: Wazo la ski ni ya zamani sana  mapendezi ya pango kuonyesha skiers tarehe nyuma kama mbali kama 5000 BC!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.
hypothesis: Urefu wa ski unaanza karne ya 17, na mwaka wa 1861 watu wa Norway walianzisha klabu ya kwanza ya ski nchini Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.
hypothesis: Kufanya safari ya ski: Shughuli hii pia huitwa backcountry ski, ski touring au ski hiking.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.
hypothesis: Ni kuhusiana lakini kwa kawaida si kuhusisha alpine style ski ziara au kupanda milima, mwisho wale kufanyika katika eneo la mhimili na zinahitaji sana ngumu ski na viatu.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.
hypothesis: Fikiria njia ya ski kama njia ya kutembea kwa miguu kama hiyo.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.
hypothesis: Katika hali nzuri utakuwa na uwezo wa kukimbia umbali kubwa kidogo kuliko kutembea  lakini mara chache sana utakuwa kupata kasi ya ski cross-country bila mfuko mzito wa nyuma katika njia za kutunza.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.
hypothesis: Ulaya ni bara ndogo lakini lina nchi nyingi za kujitegemea.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, eneo la Schengen linafanya kazi kama nchi moja katika suala hili.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.
hypothesis: Kwa muda mrefu kama wewe kukaa katika eneo hili, unaweza kwa ujumla kuvuka mipaka bila kupita kupitia vituo vya kudhibiti pasipoti tena.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.
hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo, kwa kuwa na visa vya Schengen, hutahitaji kuomba visa kwa kila moja ya nchi wanachama wa Schengen kwa njia tofauti, na hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na kazi ya hati.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.
hypothesis: Hakuna utambulisho wa kilimwengu wa vitu vilivyotengenezwa kuwa vitu vya kale.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.
hypothesis: Ufafanuzi huo una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa mfupi katika maeneo kama vile Amerika Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.
hypothesis: Bidhaa za mikono zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama vitu vya kale, ingawa ni vijana kuliko bidhaa zinazozalishwa kwa wingi kama hizo.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.
hypothesis: Ufugaji wa nyasi ni njia muhimu ya kuishi miongoni mwa Wasami na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara ni muhimu pia kwa wengi wenye kazi nyingine.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.
hypothesis: Hata kwa utamaduni, hata hivyo, si Sámi wote wamehusika katika kilimo kikubwa cha nyuki, lakini waliishi kutoka uvuvi, uwindaji na kadhalika, na kuwa na nyuki hasa kama wanyama wa kuvuta.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.
hypothesis: Leo, wasaami wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.
hypothesis: Ingawa neno "Gypsy" hutumiwa sana, hasa miongoni mwa wasio Waromani, mara nyingi huonwa kuwa la kuumiza kwa sababu ya ushirika wake na mitazamo isiyofaa na maoni yasiyo sahihi kuhusu Waromani.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.
hypothesis: Ikiwa nchi unayotembelea itapewa maagizo ya kusafiri, huenda bima yako ya afya ya kusafiri au bima ya kukomesha safari ikathiriwa.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.
hypothesis: Huenda pia ukataka kushauriana na serikali nyingine zisizo za serikali yako, lakini ushauri wao umekusudiwa kuwapa raia wao.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, huenda raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati wakawa katika hali tofauti na za Wazungu au Waarabu.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.
hypothesis: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.
hypothesis: Maoni yaliyowasilishwa mara nyingi ni ya kijuu-juu, ya jumla na ya rahisi sana ikilinganishwa na habari zaidi zinazopatikana mahali pengine.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
