reference: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.
hypothesis: Hali ya hewa mbaya ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote ya hewa hatari ambayo inaweza kusababisha uharibifu, kuvuruga sana jamii, au kupoteza maisha ya binadamu.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.
hypothesis: Hali ya hewa mbaya inaweza kutokea mahali popote ulimwenguni, na kuna aina mbalimbali za hali hiyo, ambayo inaweza kutegemea kijiografia, eneo, na hali za anga.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.
hypothesis: Upepo mkali, mvua kubwa, mvua nyingi, na moto wa msitu ni aina na matokeo ya hali ya hewa kali, kama vile dhoruba za mvua, vimbunga, maji ya matope, na vimbunga.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.
hypothesis: Hali ya hewa kali ya mikoa na ya majira ni kama vile dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanashauriwa sana kuwa na ufahamu wa hatari yoyote ya hali ya hewa mbaya inayohusu eneo lao kwani inaweza kuathiri mipango yoyote ya kusafiri.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.
hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inaweza kuonwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mazoezi ya kitaalamu.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Utafutaji wa ‘Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama’ kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.
hypothesis: Kutafuta 'Kosi ya Mazingira Yenye Uadui' kwenye Intaneti kwaweza kutoa anwani ya kampuni ya eneo hilo.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kozi hiyo itazungumzia mambo yote yaliyozungumziwa hapa kwa undani zaidi, kwa kawaida kwa kutumia uzoefu wa kufanya kazi.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.
hypothesis: Kozi hiyo kwa kawaida huchukua siku 2 hadi 5 na inahusisha kucheza, msaada wa kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya silaha.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.
hypothesis: Vitabu na magazeti yanayozungumzia jinsi ya kuishi nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayozungumzia maeneo ya vita ni machache.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanaopanga kufanya upasuaji wa kubadili jinsia katika nchi za nje lazima wahakikishe kuwa wana hati halali za safari ya kurudi.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.
hypothesis: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti na jinsia isiyotangazwa (X) au nyaraka zilizoboreshwa ili kufanana na jina na jinsia inayotakiwa hutofautiana.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.
hypothesis: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kuheshimu hati hizo ni tofauti sana.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.
hypothesis: Vipimo vya usalama katika vituo vya ukaguzi pia vimeongezeka sana katika enzi ya baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.
hypothesis: Watu wa jinsia tofauti kabla ya upasuaji hawapaswi kutarajia kupita kupitia scanners wakiwa na faragha na heshima yao haijakamilika.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.
hypothesis: Mito ya kupasuka ni mtiririko wa kurudi kutoka mawimbi yanayoondoka kwenye pwani, mara nyingi kwenye mwamba au kitu kama hicho.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji mtiririko wa kurudi umezingatia sehemu chache za kina zaidi, na mkondo wa haraka kwenda maji ya kina unaweza kuunda huko.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.
hypothesis: Watu wengi hufa kwa sababu ya uchovu wa kujaribu kuruka dhidi ya mtiririko huo, jambo ambalo huenda likawa lisilowezekana.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.
hypothesis: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mtiririko, kuogelea nyuma si vigumu zaidi kuliko kawaida.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.
hypothesis: Jaribu kukimbilia mahali ambapo huwezi kukamatwa tena au, kulingana na ustadi wako na ikiwa umeonekana, huenda ukataka kusubiri ukombozi.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.
hypothesis: Mshtuko wa kuingia tena huja mapema kuliko mshtuko wa kitamaduni (kuna hatua ya mwezi wa asali kidogo), hudumu kwa muda mrefu, na inaweza kuwa mbaya zaidi.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.
hypothesis: Mara nyingine wasafiri ambao waliweza kuzoea utamaduni mpya kwa urahisi wanapata vigumu sana kuzoea utamaduni wa nchi yao.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.
hypothesis: Unaporudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi nje ya nchi, umejipatanisha na utamaduni mpya na umepoteza baadhi ya mazoea yako kutoka utamaduni wa nyumbani.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Wakati ulienda ng’ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.
hypothesis: Mwanzoni, watu walipokuja nje ya nchi, huenda walikuwa na subira na uelewaji, wakijua kwamba wasafiri katika nchi mpya wanahitaji kuzoea hali zao.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.
hypothesis: Huenda watu wasitazamie kwamba subira na uelewevu ni muhimu pia kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.
hypothesis: Picha ya sauti na nuru ya piramidi ni mojawapo ya mambo ya kuvutia zaidi katika eneo hilo kwa watoto.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.
hypothesis: Unaweza kuona piramidi katika giza na unaweza kuona yao katika utulivu kabla ya show kuanza.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida wewe daima hapa sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu hadithi.

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.
hypothesis: Sphinx ni msingi na mwandishi wa hadithi ndefu.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.
hypothesis: Maonyesho yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi mbalimbali zinawaka.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.
hypothesis: Visiwa vya Shetland Kusini, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadai na mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, na kumi na sita zinafanya kazi mnamo 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: Kisiwa hicho kiko kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Peninsula.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.
hypothesis: Nyingine ni kisiwa cha Livingston, na Deception ambako volkano iliyojaa maji ya maji ambayo bado ni yenye nguvu hutoa bandari ya asili yenye kustaajabisha.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Nchi ya Ellsworth ni eneo kusini mwa Peninsula, lililo na mipaka na Bahari ya Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.
hypothesis: Milima ya Peninsula hapa huunganishwa katika eneo la juu, kisha huibuka tena kuunda mlolongo wa kilomita 360 wa Milima ya Ellsworth, iliyovunjika na glacier ya Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.
hypothesis: Sehemu ya kaskazini au Sentinel Range ina milima ya juu zaidi ya Antarctica, Vinson Massif, ambayo ina kilele cha mlima Vinson wa mita 4892.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo ya mbali, bila simu za mkononi, huenda ikawa simu ya satelaiti ndiyo njia pekee ya kuchagua.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida simu ya mkononi haibadilishi simu ya mkononi, kwa kuwa ni lazima uwe nje ukiwa na mwendo wa kuona satellite ili ufanye simu.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.
hypothesis: Huduma hii hutumiwa mara nyingi na meli, ikiwa ni pamoja na vyombo vya kujifurahisha, pamoja na safari ambazo zina data ya mbali na mahitaji ya sauti.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.
hypothesis: Mtoa huduma wako wa simu wa eneo lako anapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuungana na huduma hii.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.
hypothesis: Chaguo linalozidi kujulikana kwa wale wanaopanga mwaka wa mapumziko ni kusafiri na kujifunza.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.
hypothesis: Hii ni maarufu hasa miongoni mwa wale wanaochukua darasa, kwa kuwa huwawezesha kuchukua mwaka mmoja kabla ya chuo kikuu, bila kuhatarisha elimu yao.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.
hypothesis: Katika visa vingi, kujiandikisha katika kozi ya mwaka wa pengo nje ya nchi kwaweza kweli kuboresha nafasi zako za kuhamia kwenye elimu ya juu katika nchi yako ya asili.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kuna ada ya masomo ya kujiandikisha katika programu hizo za elimu.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. “Nchi ya maziwa elfu” ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.
hypothesis: Finland ni marudio ya mashua kubwa. "Nchi ya maziwa elfu" pia ina maelfu ya visiwa, katika maziwa na katika kisiwa kisiwa.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.
hypothesis: Katika visiwa na maziwa huitaji yacht.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.
hypothesis: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi ni makubwa sana kwa ajili ya meli yoyote, mashua ndogo au hata kayak hutoa uzoefu tofauti.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
hypothesis: Kuendesha mashua ni burudani ya kitaifa nchini Finland, na kila watu saba au wanane hupata mashua.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Hii inaendana na Norway, Sweden na Nyuzilandi, lakini vinginevyo ni tofauti kabisa (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).
hypothesis: Hii ni sawa na Norway, Sweden na New Zealand, lakini vinginevyo kabisa ya kipekee (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.
hypothesis: Meli nyingi za Baltic zinaishi kwa muda mrefu huko St. Petersburg, Urusi.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.
hypothesis: Hilo linamaanisha kwamba unaweza kutembelea jiji hilo la kihistoria kwa siku chache kamili huku ukiondoka na kulala usiku kwenye meli.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).
hypothesis: Ikiwa utafika pwani kwa kutumia tu safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (katika 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.
hypothesis: Kama unavyoona kwenye ramani iliyo juu ya Berlin, hakuna mahali ambapo kuna bahari na ziara ya jiji haipatikani katika bei ya safari hiyo.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.
hypothesis: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa jambo lenye kuogopesha kwa watu wa umri na malezi mbalimbali, hasa ikiwa hawajawahi kusafiri au wamepatwa na tukio lenye kutisha.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.
hypothesis: Si jambo la kuaibika: si tofauti na hofu na chuki za kibinafsi za watu wengi sana.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.
hypothesis: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege zinavyofanya kazi na mambo yanayotukia wakati wa ndege kunaweza kuwasaidia kushinda hofu inayotegemea kutokuwa na udhibiti.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.
hypothesis: Kampuni za kupeleka barua hulipwa vizuri kwa kutoa vitu haraka. Mara nyingi, wakati ni muhimu sana kwa hati za biashara, bidhaa au sehemu za ziada kwa ajili ya ukarabati wa haraka.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.
hypothesis: Kwenye baadhi ya njia, makampuni makubwa yana ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na makampuni madogo kulikuwa na tatizo.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.
hypothesis: Ikiwa walituma bidhaa kwa usafirishaji wa hewa, huenda ikachukua siku kadhaa kupitia njia fulani za kupakia na desturi.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.
hypothesis: Njia pekee ya kupata njia ya haraka zaidi ilikuwa kuituma kama mizigo iliyoandikishwa. Sheria za mashirika ya ndege hazitawaruhusu kutuma mizigo bila abiria, ambayo ndiyo mahali unapoingia.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).
hypothesis: Njia ya wazi ya kuruka katika darasa la kwanza au la biashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa ajili ya pendeleo hilo (au, bora zaidi, kupata kampuni yako kufanya hivyo kwa ajili yako).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, si rahisi kufanya hivyo: kwa kufuata sheria za kawaida, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya gharama za kawaida za biashara, na mara kumi na moja kwa ajili ya darasa la kwanza!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.
hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, hakuna maana hata kutafuta punguzo kwa ajili ya viti vya biashara au vya darasa la kwanza kwenye ndege za moja kwa moja kutoka A hadi B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.
hypothesis: Mashirika ya ndege yajua vizuri kwamba kuna kikundi fulani cha msingi cha wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa dola kubwa kwa pendeleo la kupata mahali fulani kwa haraka na kwa faraja, na kulipa kwa kufaa.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.
hypothesis: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chişinău. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiromania, lakini Kirusi hutumiwa sana.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
reference: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.
hypothesis: Moldova ni jamhuri ya kikabila nyingi ambayo imeteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.

source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
reference: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
hypothesis: Mwaka 1994, mgogoro huo uliongoza kwenye kuanzishwa kwa Jamhuri ya Transnistria iliyojitangaza katika mashariki mwa Moldova, ambayo ina serikali na sarafu yake mwenyewe lakini haijulikani na nchi yoyote ya wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.

source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
reference: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.
hypothesis: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kushindwa kwa mazungumzo ya kisiasa.

source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
reference: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.
hypothesis: Dini kuu nchini Moldova ni Ukristo wa Othodoksi.

source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
reference: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.
hypothesis: İzmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu karibu milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha usafiri.

source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
reference: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.
hypothesis: Wakati mmoja jiji la kale la Smurna, sasa ni kituo cha kisasa, chenye maendeleo, na chenye shughuli nyingi cha kibiashara, kilichozungukwa na ukingo mkubwa na milima.

source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
reference: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.
hypothesis: Barabara pana, majengo yenye kioo na vituo vya biashara vya kisasa vimejaa paa za jadi zenye matawi ya rangi nyekundu, soko la karne ya 18, na misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji hilo lina mazingira ya Ulaya ya Mediterania kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.

source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
reference: Kijiji cha Haldarsvik kina mtazamo wa kisiwa kilicho karibu cha Eysturoi na kina kanisa lenye umbo lisilo la kawaida la pembe nane.
hypothesis: Kijiji cha Haldarsvík kina maoni ya kisiwa cha Eysturoy kilicho karibu na kina kanisa la kawaida lenye pembe nane.

source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
reference: Katika uwanja wa kanisa, kuna vinyago vya kuvutia vya marumaru vya njiwa juu ya kaburi.
hypothesis: Kwenye uwanja wa makanisa, kuna sanamu za marumaru za njiwa zenye kuvutia juu ya makaburi fulani.

source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
reference: Inafaa nusu saa kutembeatembea katika kijiji hicho ambacho kinavutia.
hypothesis: Ni muhimu kutembea kwa nusu saa katika kijiji hicho chenye kuvutia.

source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
reference: Upande wa kaskazini na mahali rahisi kufika kuna mji wa mahaba na wa kuvutia, uliofanywa maarufu na wageni baada ya kusimulia mapambo yake ya kung'aa kama yalivyorekodiwa na Lord Byron.
hypothesis: Kaskazini na kwa urahisi ni mji wa Sintra wenye kupendeza na wenye kupendeza ambao ulijulikana na wageni baada ya kutaja kwa uchangamfu utukufu wake uliorekodiwa na Lord Byron.

source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
reference: Basi la Skotabu 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na kusimama Kabo da Roka.
hypothesis: Scotturb Bus 403 husafiri kwa ukawaida hadi Sintra, ikisimama katika Cabo da Roca.

source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
reference: Pia upande wa kaskazini tembelea Hekalu la Mama Yetu Fatima (Madhabahu), mahali maarufu duniani pa maonyesho ya Maria.
hypothesis: Pia kaskazini tembelea Patakatifu pa Kubwa pa Mama Yetu wa Fatima (Shrine), mahali pa maonyesho ya Mariamu yenye umaarufu ulimwenguni pote.

source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
reference: Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa hasa unatembelea mahali penye kaburi la watu wengi, na pia mahali ambapo pana maana isiyoweza kutabiriwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu ulimwenguni.
hypothesis: Tafadhali kumbuka kwamba wewe ni kimsingi kutembelea eneo la makaburi ya pamoja, pamoja na tovuti ambayo ina maana karibu isiyoweza kuhesabiwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu duniani.

source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
reference: Kungali kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai walioishi muda wao hapa, na wengine wengi ambao wapendwa wao waliuawa au walifanyishwa kazi hadi kufa, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi vilevile.
hypothesis: Bado kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai ambao waliokoka wakati wao hapa, na wengi zaidi ambao walikuwa na wapendwa ambao waliuawa au kufanya kazi hadi kifo huko, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi kwa usawa.

source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
reference: Tafadhali tendea mahali hapo kwa hadhi yote, utaratibu na heshima inayostahiki. Usifanye utani juu ya Maangamizo au Wanazi.
hypothesis: Tafadhali tambua tovuti hiyo kwa heshima, heshima na heshima inayostahili.

source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
reference: Usiumbue tovuti kwa kuashiria au kukata michoro kwenye miundo.
hypothesis: Usiharibu tovuti kwa kuweka alama au kuchonga picha kwenye miundo.

source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
reference: Lugha rasmi za Baselona Kikatalani na Kihispania. Takribani nusu yao wanapendelea kuongea Kikatalani, idadi kubwa wanaielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.
hypothesis: Lugha rasmi za Barcelona ni Kikatalani na Kihispania. Karibu nusu huzungumza Kikatalani, wengi huielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.

source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
reference: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa tu kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu sheria huitangaza kuwa lugha ya kwanza rasmi.

source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
reference: Kihispania bado hutumika sana katika uchukuzi wa umma na maeneo mengine.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, Kihispania hutumiwa sana katika usafiri wa umma na katika vifaa vingine.

source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
reference: Matangazo ya mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kitalani, lakini usumbufu usiopangwa hutangazwa kwa mifumo otomatiki kwa kutumia lugha mbalimbali zikiwemo Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapanisi.
hypothesis: Matangazo ya kawaida katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kikatalani, lakini mapungufu yasiyopangwa huarifiwa na mfumo wa kiotomatiki katika lugha mbalimbali ikiwa ni pamoja na Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapani.

source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
reference: Waparisi wana sifa ya kujipenda, jeuri na wenye kiburi.
hypothesis: Wafarisayo wana sifa ya kuwa wenye kujipenda wenyewe, wa kiburi na wenye kiburi.

source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
reference: Wakati hii mara nyingi ni aina ya dhana tu isiyofaa, njia nzuri ya kupatana kule Paris bado ni kuwa katika tabia yako njema, kufanya kama mtu ambaye ni “bien e’lev’e” (amelelewa vizuri). Itafanya kupatana rahisi mno.
hypothesis: Ingawa mara nyingi hii ni mtindo-mfano usio sahihi, njia bora ya kuelewana katika Paris bado ni kwa kuwa na tabia yako bora, ukijiendesha kama mtu ambaye ni "bien élevé" (aliyekua vizuri).

source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
reference: Umbo za nje za ghafla za Parisiani zitayeyuka haraka ikiwa unaonyesha ustahifu kadhaa za kimsingi.
hypothesis: Maonekano ya nje ya ghafula ya Waparisi yataharibika haraka ikiwa utaonyesha adabu za msingi.

source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
reference: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Plitvice Lakes ina misitu sana, hususan mifune, misonobari, na miti ya misonobari, na mchanganyiko wa uoto wa safu ya milima ya Alp na mediterania.
hypothesis: Hifadhi ya kitaifa ya Ziwa la Plitvice ina misitu mingi, hasa miti ya beech, spruce, na fir, na ina mchanganyiko wa mimea ya Alpine na Mediterania.

source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
reference: Ina aina anuwai za jamii za mimea, kutokana na masafa yake ya hali ndogondogo za anga, mchanga tofauti na kutofautiana kwa viwango vya urefu.
hypothesis: Ina aina kubwa ya jamii za mimea, kutokana na mbalimbali zake microclimates, udongo tofauti na viwango mbalimbali vya urefu.

source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
reference: Eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani mwa aina nyingi sana mbalimbali za spishi za wanyama na ndege.
hypothesis: Pia, eneo hilo lina wanyama na ndege wengi sana.

source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
reference: Wanyama nadra kama vile Dubu wa hudhurungi wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, bundi, simba-mangu, paka mwitu na kware wa Ulaya wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.
hypothesis: Kuna wanyama wachache kama vile dubu mweusi wa Ulaya, mbwa-mwitu, tai, ndoo, chui, paka mwitu, na chungu, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida

source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
reference: Wakati wa kutembelea nyumba za watawa, wanawake wanatarajiwa kuvaa sketi zinazofunika magoti na pia wafunike mabega yao.
hypothesis: Wanawake wanapoenda kwenye makao ya watawa, wanapaswa kuvaa koti la kufunika magoti na kufunika mabega yao pia.

source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
reference: Nyingi za monasteri hutoa kanga kwa wanawake wanaokuja bila, lakini ukija na kanga yako, haswa iliyo na rangi kali, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa monaki au sista kwenye kiingilio.
hypothesis: Maeneo mengi ya watawa huwaandalia wanawake walio nje bila kujitayarisha, lakini ukileta yako, hasa moja yenye rangi nyepesi, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa mtawa au mtawa kwenye mlango.

source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
reference: Vile vile, wanaume wanahitajika kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.
hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo, wanaume wanapaswa kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.

source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
reference: Hii pia inaweza kuombwa kutoka kwa akiba kwenye lango lakini nguo hizo hazifuliwi baada ya kila mtumiaji kwa hivyo huenda usijihisi mwenye starehe unapovaa sketi hizo. Saizi moja hutosha wote kwa wanaume!
hypothesis: Hii pia inaweza kukopwa kutoka hisa kwenye mlango lakini nguo hizo hazioshawi baada ya kila mtumiaji ili usijihisi vizuri kuvaa sukari hizi.

source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
reference: Vyakula vya Majokan, kama vile vya sehemu nyingine kwenye kanda ya bahari ya Mediterranean, vimetengenezwa kwa mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mizeituni nyakati zote.
hypothesis: Vyakula vya Mallorca, kama vile vyakula vya maeneo ya Mediterania, hutumia mkate, mboga, na nyama (hasa nyama ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya zeituni katika sehemu zote.

source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
reference: Chakula rahisi cha jioni, hasa wakati wa kiangazi, huwa ni Pa ambi Oli: Mkate wa mafuta ya mizeituni, nyanya, na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana kama vile jibini na samakituna.
hypothesis: Mlo wa jioni rahisi, hasa wakati wa majira ya joto, ni Pa amb Oli: Mkate na mafuta ya zeituni, nyanya, na viungo yoyote inapatikana kama vile jibini, tuna, nk.

source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
reference: Nomino zote, ikiwemo Sie kwa wewe, daima huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katika katikati mwa sentensi.
hypothesis: Majina yote, pamoja na neno Sie kwako, huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katikati ya sentensi.

source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
reference: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.
hypothesis: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.

source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
reference: Pia bila shaka inafanya kusoma rahisi, ingawa kuandika kwa kiasi fulani ni ngumu kwa haja ya kutaka kujua kama kitenzi au kivumishi kinatumika kwa umuhimu.
hypothesis: Pia, inaweza kusemwa kwamba inafanya kusoma kuwa rahisi, ingawa kuandika ni vigumu kwa sababu ya uhitaji wa kujua ikiwa kitenzi au kitenzi hutumiwa kwa njia ya msingi.

source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
reference: Matamshi ni rahisi kiasi kwa Kiitaliano kwani maneno mengi hutamkwa hasa yalivyoandikwa
hypothesis: Kutamka maneno kwa Kiitaliano ni rahisi kwa kuwa maneno mengi yanatamka kwa usahihi

source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
reference: Herufi muhimu za kuzingatia ni c na g, kwani matamshi yake hubadilika kulingana na vokali inayofuata.
hypothesis: Herufi kuu ambazo zinapaswa kujihadhari ni c na g, kwa kuwa matamshi yao yanatofautiana kulingana na vokali ifuatayo.

source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
reference: Pia, hakikisha kutamka r na rr tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpenzi, ilhali carro inamaanisha gari la kuvurutwa na farasi.
hypothesis: Pia, hakikisha kwamba unatamka r na rr kwa njia tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpendwa, wakati carro inamaanisha gari.

source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
reference: Kiajemi ina sarufi rahisi kiasi, na mara nyingi ya kawaida.
hypothesis: Kipersi kina sarufi rahisi na mara nyingi ni za kawaida.

source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
reference: Kwa hivyo, kusoma chanzo hiki cha sarufi kutakusaidia wewe kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kiajemi na kuelewa bora zaidi.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, kusoma kitabu hiki cha msingi cha lugha ya Kigiriki kutakusaidia kujifunza mengi kuhusu lugha ya Kigiriki na kuelewa misemo vizuri zaidi.

source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
reference: Bila haja ya kusema, ikiwa unaifahamu lugha ya mahaba, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.
hypothesis: Bila shaka, ukijua lugha ya Kiromani, utajifunza Kireno kwa urahisi zaidi.

source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
reference: Hata hivyo, watu wanaofahamu Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kuhitimisha kwa haraka kuwa Kireno kinakaribiana sana na kwamba hakihitaji kusomwa kando.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, watu wanaojua Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kukata kauli haraka kwamba Kireno ni lugha ya karibu sana hivi kwamba haitaji kujifunza kiingereza kwa njia tofauti.

source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
reference: Uchunguzi kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida hautumiki leo, na hubaki kama makavazi, ama sehemu za elimu.
hypothesis: Mazingira ya kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida yamekoma leo, na yanabaki kuwa makumbusho, au maeneo ya elimu.

source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
reference: Kwani uchafuzi wa mwanga nyakati zao haukuwa shida kama ilivyo leo, mara nyingi wako mijini au katikavyuo vikuu, rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zimejengwa siku za kisasa.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa uchafuzi wa mwangaza katika siku zao za kifahari haukuwa tatizo kama leo, kwa kawaida hufanywa katika majiji au kwenye vyuo vikuu, na ni rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zilizojengwa katika nyakati za kisasa.

source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
reference: Darubini nyingi za utafiti za kisasa ni vifaa kuu katika maeneo ya mbali yaliyo na hali nzuri za angahewa.
hypothesis: Teleskopu nyingi za kisasa za utafiti ni vifaa vikubwa katika maeneo ya mbali yenye hali nzuri ya hewa.

source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
reference: Utazamaji wa maua ya cheri, inayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.
hypothesis: Kuangalia maua ya cherry, yanayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Japani tangu karne ya 8.

source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
reference: Dhana hiyo ilitoka Uchina ambapo maua ya plamu ndiyo yaliyokuwa maua yaliyopendelewa.
hypothesis: Wazo hilo lilitoka China ambapo maua ya plum yalikuwa maua ya kupendwa.

source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
reference: Huko Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya mcheri ziliandaliwa na maliki kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa upatanishi waliozunguka Mahakama ya Imperi.
hypothesis: Katika Japani, maliki ndiye aliyeandaa karamu za kwanza za maua ya cherry kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa aristocracy walio karibu na jumba la kifalme.

source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
reference: Mimea inaonekana bora ikiwa katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka kishawishi cha kutoa hata kiolezo "kimoja tu".
hypothesis: Mimea inaonekana vizuri zaidi katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hiyo epuka kishawishi cha kuondoa hata sampuli "moja tu".

source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
reference: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya “violezo” pia kutakufanya uodolewe, bila majadiliano.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyoandaliwa rasmi, kukusanya "vipande" pia kutakufanya uondolewe nje, bila kujadiliwa.

source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
reference: Singapori kwa ujumla ni mahali salama zaidi kuwa na rahisi sana kuabiri, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.
hypothesis: Singapore kwa ujumla ni mahali salama sana na rahisi sana kuvinjari, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.

source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
reference: Lakini kwa kuwekwa katika “tropiki za juu” digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa istiwai utahitaji kukabiliana na joto jingi (kila wakati) na jua kali (wakati anga ni safi, nadra zaidi).
hypothesis: Lakini ukiwa katika "vitropiki vya juu" digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa ikweta utahitaji kukabiliana na joto (sikuzote) na jua kali (wakati anga lina wazi, mara chache zaidi).

source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
reference: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoelekea kaskazini mwa Hebroni, mahali pa makaburi ya jadi ya mashujaa wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.
hypothesis: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoenda kaskazini hadi Hebroni, mahali pa kale pa kuzikia wazee wa ukoo wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.

source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
reference: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalofikiria kuabiri linaenda Hebron na si katika makazi ya karibu ya Kiyahudi ya Kiryat Arba tu.
hypothesis: Hakikisha kwamba basi unayotaka kuchukua huenda Hebroni na si tu kwenye makazi ya Kiyahudi ya karibu ya Kiryat Arba.

source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
reference: Njia za maji za barani zinaweza kuwa mandhari mzuri ya kufanyia likizo.
hypothesis: Njia za maji za ndani za nchi zinaweza kuwa mandhari nzuri ya kuanzisha likizo.

source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
reference: Kwa mfano, kutembelea ngome katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri katika maeneo ya kuvutia kwa Danube au kusafiri kwa mashua upande wa Mfereji wa Erie.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, kutembelea majumba katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri kwa meli kwenda kwenye majiji ya kuvutia kwenye Mto Danube au kutembea kwa mashua kwenye Mfereji wa Erie.

source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
reference: Pia wao hufafanua njia maarufu za matembezi na uendeshaji baiskeli.
hypothesis: Pia, hufafanua njia za kutembea na kuendesha baiskeli.

source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
reference: Krismasi ni moja ya likizo muhimu zaidi ya Ukristo, na inaadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.
hypothesis: Krismasi ni mojawapo ya sikukuu muhimu zaidi za Ukristo, na huadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa ya Yesu.

source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
reference: Nyingi za tamaduni zinazozunguka likizo zimesilikwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo duniani kote.
hypothesis: Desturi nyingi zinazozunguka sikukuu hiyo zimepitishwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo ulimwenguni pote.

source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
reference: Kuna desturi ya kukesha usiku wa Pasaka katika sehemu fulani wazi ili kuona jua likichomoza.
hypothesis: Kuna desturi ya kutumia usiku wa Pasaka akiwa amelala mahali fulani ili kuona kuchomoza kwa jua.

source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
reference: Kwa kweli kuna maelezo ya thiolojia ya Kikristo ya utamaduni huu, lakini pia huenda ikawa ibada ya Majira ya kuchipua na Uzazi kabla ya Ukristo.
hypothesis: Bila shaka kuna maelezo ya kitheolojia ya Kikristo kwa utamaduni huu, lakini huenda ikawa ni desturi ya mapema ya Ukristo ya Msimu wa Mapema na Uzazi.

source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
reference: Makanisa zaidi ya jadi huwa na Mkesha wa Pasaka usiku wa Jumamosi wakati wa wikendi ya Pasaka, waumini wakisherehekea saa sita kamili za usiku kuadhimisha ufufuo wa Kristo.
hypothesis: Makanisa ya kitamaduni zaidi mara nyingi huadhimisha Ukumbusho wa Ista Jumamosi usiku wakati wa mwisho wa juma la Ista, na mara nyingi makutaniko huanza kusherehekea usiku wa manane ili kusherehekea ufufuo wa Kristo.

source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
reference: Wanyama wote asili waliofika katika visiwa hivi walikuja hapa pengine kwa kuogelea, kupaa au kuelea.
hypothesis: Wanyama wote waliokuja kwenye visiwa hivyo walikuja hapa kwa kuogelea, kuruka au kuteleza.

source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
reference: Kwa sababu ya masafa marefu kutoka kwa bara, mamalia walishindwa kumalize mwendo, huku mzee kobe jitu akiwa mnyama wa kimsingi mla nyasi katika Galapagosi.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya umbali mrefu kutoka bara, wanyama-wanyama hawakuweza kufanya safari hiyo na kufanya nzige mkubwa kuwa mnyama wa kwanza wa malisho katika Visiwa vya Galapagos.

source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
reference: Tangu kuwasili kwa mwanadamu katika Galapagos, mamalia wengi wamewasilishwa pamoja na mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.
hypothesis: Tangu kuwasili kwa mwanadamu kwenye Visiwa vya Galapagos, wanyama wengi wa kulevya wameletwa, kutia ndani mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.

source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
reference: Ukitembelea maeneo ya Aktiki na Antaktiki msimu wa baridi utapata tajriba ya usiku wa pola, ambayo ina maana kuwa jua halichomozi juu ya upeo wa macho.
hypothesis: Ukienda Arctic au Antarctic wakati wa baridi utaona usiku wa polar, ambayo inamaanisha jua haliishi juu ya upeo.

source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
reference: Hii inatoa fursa nzuri ya kuona mwanga wa Aurora, kwani anga itakuwa giza kwa kadiri fulani mchana na usiku.
hypothesis: Hilo linatoa fursa nzuri ya kuona Aurora borealis, kwa kuwa anga litakuwa giza zaidi au chini kila saa.

source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
reference: Kwa kuwa maeneo hayo hayana idadi kubwa ya watu, na uchafuzi kidogo aghalabu huwa si tatizo, pia utaweza kufuruhia nyota.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa maeneo hayo hayana wakazi wengi, na kwa hiyo uchafuzi wa mwangaza mara nyingi si tatizo, utaweza pia kufurahia nyota.

source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
reference: Desturi ya kazi ya Kijapani ni ya kimfumo na rasmi kuliko mazoea ya Wanamagharibi.
hypothesis: Utamaduni wa kazi wa Japani ni wa kijumla na rasmi zaidi kuliko ule ambao watu wa Magharibi wanaweza kuwa wamezoea.

source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
reference: Suti ni mavazi ya kawaida ya kibiashara, na wafanyikazi huita wenzao kwa majina ya familia zao au kwa majina ya kikazi.
hypothesis: Mavazi ni mavazi ya kawaida ya biashara, na wafanyakazi wenzako wanapigana majina ya familia au majina ya kazi.

source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
reference: Ulinganifu katika mahali pa kazi ni muhimu, kusisitiza juhudi za vikundi badala ya kusifu mafanikio ya kibinafsi.
hypothesis: Kufanya kazi kwa upatano ni muhimu, kwa kuwa jitihada za kikundi zinakaziwa zaidi kuliko kusifiwa kwa mafanikio ya mtu mmoja-mmoja.

source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
reference: Mara kwa mara wafanyakazi hupata kibali cha maamuzi yoyote wanayofanya kutoka kwa wasimamizi wao, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakuu wao bila maswali.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi wafanyakazi wanapaswa kupata idhini ya wakuu wao kwa ajili ya maamuzi yoyote wanayofanya, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakuu wao bila kuhojiwa.
